savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old man who takes ibuprofen daily for arthritis presents with hematemesis and hypotension. Endoscopy shows a deep ulcer in the posterior wall of the duodenal bulb with an actively bleeding vessel.
savollar.savol: Which artery is most likely bleeding?
savollar.izoh: Duodenum bulbusining ORQA devoridagi yara orqasida oshqozon-o'n ikki barmoq arteriyasi (GDA) yotadi - kuchli qon ketishning klassik manbai.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Artrit uchun har kuni ibuprofen ichadigan 58 yoshli erkak qon qusish va gipotenziya bilan keldi. Endoskopiyada o'n ikki barmoqli ichak bulbusining orqa devorida chuqur yara va undan faol qon ketayotgan tomir aniqlandi.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi arteriyadan qon ketayotgani ehtimoli eng yuqori?

savollar.vinyetka: A 66-year-old woman has melena and dizziness. Endoscopy reveals a gastric ulcer on the lesser curvature of the stomach that has eroded into an adjacent artery.
savollar.savol: Which artery has most likely been eroded?
savollar.izoh: Kichik egrilik bo'ylab chap oshqozon arteriyasi yuradi - kichik egrilik yarasi shu arteriyani yemiradi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 66 yoshli ayolda melena va bosh aylanishi bor. Endoskopiyada oshqozonning kichik egriligida qo'shni arteriyani yemirgan yara topildi.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi arteriya yemirilgan bo'lishi ehtimoli eng yuqori?

savollar.vinyetka: A 45-year-old man with long-standing epigastric pain develops sudden severe abdominal pain and a rigid abdomen. He also reports pain at the tip of his right shoulder. Upright chest x-ray shows air under the diaphragm.
savollar.savol: The shoulder pain is carried by which nerve roots?
savollar.izoh: Old devor duodenal yarasi teshilib, havo diafragma ostiga chiqdi. Diafragma ta'sirlanishi frenik nerv (C3-C5) orqali yelka og'rig'i beradi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Uzoq vaqtdan beri epigastral og'rig'i bo'lgan 45 yoshli erkakda to'satdan kuchli qorin og'rig'i va taxtasimon qorin paydo bo'ldi. U o'ng yelka uchida ham og'riq sezmoqda. Tik holatdagi rentgenda diafragma ostida havo bor.
savollar.savol_uz: Yelka og'rig'i qaysi nerv ildizlari orqali uzatiladi?

savollar.vinyetka: A thin 24-year-old man has recurrent left flank pain and episodes of gross hematuria. Examination shows a left-sided scrotal varicocele that does not decompress when supine. Doppler shows a dilated left renal vein proximal to the aorta.
savollar.savol: Which structure compresses the vein?
savollar.izoh: Nutcracker sindromi: chap buyrak venasi AMS va aorta orasida siqiladi. Chap moyak venasi chap buyrak venasiga quyilgani uchun chap varikotsele.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Ozg'in 24 yoshli erkakda takroriy chap bel og'rig'i va makrogematuriya xurujlari bor. Ko'rikda yotganda kichraymaydigan chap varikotsele aniqlandi. Dopplerda aortadan oldingi qismda kengaygan chap buyrak venasi ko'rindi.
savollar.savol_uz: Venani qaysi tuzilma siqmoqda?

savollar.vinyetka: A 19-year-old woman lost 15 kg over 3 months due to anorexia nervosa. She now has postprandial epigastric pain, early satiety and bilious vomiting that improves in the knee-chest position. Imaging shows a dilated stomach and proximal duodenum.
savollar.savol: Compression of which structure explains her symptoms?
savollar.izoh: AMS sindromi: tutqich yog'i kamayib, aorta-AMS burchagi torayadi va duodenumning III (gorizontal) qismi siqiladi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 19 yoshli ayol anoreksiya tufayli 3 oyda 15 kg ozdi. Hozir ovqatdan keyin epigastral og'riq, erta to'yish va tizza-ko'krak holatida yengillashadigan safroli qusish bor. Tasvirda oshqozon va proksimal duodenum kengaygan.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi tuzilmaning siqilishi belgilarni tushuntiradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 74-year-old man becomes hypotensive during cardiac surgery. Two days later he has left-sided abdominal pain and bloody diarrhea. CT shows wall thickening of the colon at one region.
savollar.savol: Which segment is most likely affected?
savollar.izoh: Ishemik kolit: SMA va IMA chegarasidagi watershed zona - taloq burilishi (va to'g'ri-sigmasimon chegara) gipotenziyada birinchi zararlanadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 74 yoshli erkakda yurak operatsiyasi vaqtida gipotenziya bo'ldi. Ikki kundan keyin chap tomonda qorin og'rig'i va qonli ich ketishi boshlandi. KT da chambar ichakning bir sohasida devor qalinlashgan.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi qism zararlangan bo'lishi ehtimoli eng yuqori?

savollar.vinyetka: A 35-year-old woman with Crohn disease underwent resection of 100 cm of terminal ileum 4 years ago. She now has fatigue, glossitis, paresthesias of the feet and macrocytic anemia.
savollar.savol: Malabsorption of which nutrient explains these findings?
savollar.izoh: B12 terminal ileumda ichki omil bilan so'riladi. Rezeksiyadan yillar o'tib makrotsitar anemiya va neyropatiya - B12 tanqisligi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Kron kasalligi bo'lgan 35 yoshli ayolga 4 yil oldin terminal ileumning 100 sm qismi rezeksiya qilingan. Hozir unda holsizlik, glossit, oyoqlarda uvishish va makrotsitar anemiya bor.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi moddaning so'rilmasligi bu belgilarni tushuntiradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 42-year-old woman had a Roux-en-Y gastric bypass 3 years ago, which bypasses the duodenum. She now has fatigue, pica and a microcytic anemia with low ferritin.
savollar.savol: Where is the deficient nutrient normally absorbed?
savollar.izoh: Temir asosan duodenumda Fe2+ shaklida so'riladi. Duodenum chetlab o'tilsa temir tanqisligi anemiyasi rivojlanadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 42 yoshli ayolga 3 yil oldin duodenumni chetlab o'tuvchi Roux-en-Y gastroshunt operatsiyasi qilingan. Hozir holsizlik, pika va ferritini past mikrotsitar anemiya bor.
savollar.savol_uz: Tanqis modda normada qayerda so'riladi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 55-year-old man with alcoholic cirrhosis vomits a large amount of bright red blood. Endoscopy shows bleeding varices in the distal esophagus.
savollar.savol: Which portal vein tributary feeds these varices?
savollar.izoh: Qizilo'ngach varikozlari: portal tomondan chap oshqozon venasi, sistemik tomondan qizilo'ngach venalari (azygosga quyiladi).
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Alkogolli sirrozi bo'lgan 55 yoshli erkak ko'p miqdorda tiniq qizil qon qusdi. Endoskopiyada qizilo'ngachning pastki qismida qonayotgan varikozlar aniqlandi.
savollar.savol_uz: Bu varikozlarni darvoza venasining qaysi irmog'i to'ldiradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 60-year-old man with cirrhosis and ascites has dilated, tortuous veins radiating from the umbilicus across the anterior abdominal wall.
savollar.savol: Which veins connect the portal system to these superficial veins?
savollar.izoh: Meduza boshi: kindik atrofi venalari (lig. teres bo'ylab) portal tizimni qorin old devori epigastral venalari bilan bog'laydi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Sirrozi va astsiti bo'lgan 60 yoshli erkakda kindikdan qorin old devori bo'ylab tarqalgan kengaygan, egri-bugri venalar bor.
savollar.savol_uz: Portal tizimni bu yuza venalar bilan qaysi venalar bog'laydi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 57-year-old man with cirrhosis and recurrent variceal bleeding undergoes placement of a stent between the portal vein and a hepatic vein. One week later he is confused and has a flapping tremor of the hands.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely cause of his new symptoms?
savollar.izoh: TIPS portal qonni jigarni chetlab sistemaga o'tkazadi - ammiak tozalanmaydi va jigar entsefalopatiyasi (asterixis) rivojlanadi.

IVC via the internal pudendal vein
savollar.izoh: Ichki gemorroy taroqsimon chiziqdan yuqorida, og'riqsiz. Yuqori to'g'ri ichak venasi -> VMI -> darvoza venasi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 52-year-old man with HIV has a painful anal mass. Biopsy shows squamous cell carcinoma arising below the pectinate line.
savollar.savol: To which lymph nodes would this tumor first spread?
savollar.izoh: Taroqsimon chiziqdan pastki qism (ektoderma) limfasi yuza chov tugunlariga oqadi; yuqori qism - ichki yonbosh tugunlariga.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: OIV infeksiyasi bor 52 yoshli erkakda og'riqli anal o'sma bor. Biopsiyada taroqsimon chiziqdan pastda o'sgan yassi hujayrali karsinoma aniqlandi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 23-year-old woman ingests a large amount of acetaminophen. Three days later her transaminases are markedly elevated and a liver biopsy is performed.
savollar.savol: Which region of the hepatic lobule shows the most necrosis?
savollar.izoh: Zona III da sitoxrom P450 eng ko'p va kislorod eng kam - paratsetamolning toksik metaboliti (NAPQI) sentrolobulyar nekroz beradi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 23 yoshli ayol ko'p miqdorda paratsetamol (atsetaminofen) ichdi. Uch kundan keyin transaminazalar keskin oshgan va jigar biopsiyasi olindi.
savollar.savol_uz: Jigar bo'lakchasining qaysi sohasida nekroz eng kuchli?

savollar.vinyetka: A 50-year-old man with chronic hepatitis C develops progressive liver fibrosis. Research shows that cells in the space of Disse lose their vitamin A droplets and begin producing collagen.
savollar.savol: Which cells are these?
savollar.izoh: Ito (yulduzsimon) hujayralar Disse bo'shlig'ida A vitaminini saqlaydi; faollashganda kollagen ishlab chiqarib fibrozga sabab bo'ladi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Surunkali gepatit C bo'lgan 50 yoshli erkakda jigar fibrozi kuchaymoqda. Tadqiqotda Disse bo'shlig'idagi hujayralar A vitamini tomchilarini yo'qotib, kollagen ishlab chiqara boshlagani ko'rsatildi.
savollar.savol_uz: Bu qanday hujayralar?

savollar.vinyetka: A 12-year-old boy develops typhoid fever after eating contaminated food. Salmonella Typhi enters the body by crossing specialized epithelial cells overlying lymphoid follicles in the distal ileum.
savollar.savol: Which cells normally sample luminal antigens at this site?
savollar.izoh: Peyer pilakchalari ustidagi M hujayralar antigenlarni olib immun hujayralarga beradi; Salmonella shu yo'l bilan kiradi. Natija - IgA javobi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 12 yoshli bola ifloslangan ovqat yegandan keyin qorin tifi bilan kasallandi. Salmonella Typhi distal ileumdagi limfoid follikullar ustidagi maxsus epiteliy hujayralari orqali organizmga kiradi.

xulosa: Oldingi ichak - seliak stvoli (T12/L1), o'rta ichak - AMS (L1), orqa ichak - AMI (L3).
Seliak stvoli 3 tarmoq beradi: chap me'da, taloq va umumiy jigar arteriyalari.
O'n ikki barmoqli ichak orqa yarasi - a. gastroduodenalis; me'da kichik egrilik yarasi - a. gastrica sinistra.
Watershed zonalar: taloq egilmasi (Griffits) va rektosigmoid tutashuv (Sudek) - ishemik kolit.
Nutcracker: chap buyrak venasi aorta va AMS orasida eziladi - gematuriya, chap varikotsele.
AMS sindromi: duodenumning 3-qismi aorta va AMS orasida eziladi - tez ozgandan keyin qusish.
Temir - duodenum, foliy - och ichak, B12 - terminal ileum.
Darvoza venasi = yuqori tutqich + taloq venalari; jigarga qonning ~75 foizini olib keladi.
Portokaval anastomozlar: qizilo'ngach varikozi, 'meduza boshi', rektal varikoz; TIPS - portal bosimni tushiradi.
Tishsimon chiziqdan yuqorida - ichki gemorroy (og'riqsiz), pastda - tashqi gemorroy (og'riqli); jigar III zonasi ishemiyaga eng sezgir.

bandlar: Renal arteries arise from the aorta at about L1-L2, just below the SMA
Right renal artery is longer and passes behind the IVC
At the hilum: vein in front, artery in the middle, pelvis behind
Segmental arteries are end arteries - occlusion causes segmental infarct
postlar.izoh:
🩸 Buyrak arteriyalari (a. renalis) qorin aortasining yon tomonlaridan, taxminan L1-L2 sathida, yuqori tutqich arteriyasidan (AMS) sal pastroqda chiqadi.

• O'NG buyrak arteriyasi uzunroq - aorta chapda yotgani uchun u pastki kovak venaning (IVC) ORQASIDAN o'tadi;
• CHAP buyrak arteriyasi kalta.

🔀 Shoxlanishi: a. renalis -> darvoza oldidagi (prehilar) oldingi va orqa tarmoqlar -> SEGMENTAR arteriyalar (odatda 5 ta) -> bo'lakaro -> yoysimon -> interlobulyar -> AFFERENT arteriola.
Tarmoqlardan buyrak usti bezining pastki arteriyasi, kapsula va siydik yo'li tarmoqlari ham chiqadi.

⚠️ Segmentar arteriyalar o'zaro anastomoz QILMAYDI (oxirgi arteriyalar) - bittasi berkilsa, o'sha segment infarkti (ponasimon) yuz beradi.

🧭 Darvozadagi tartib (oldindan orqaga): VENA - ARTERIYA - JOM (V-A-P).

Rasmda (Spalteholz) aortaning qorin qismi va undan chiqqan a. renalis ko'rinadi.

bandlar: Left renal vein is long: crosses in front of the aorta, below the SMA
Receives the left suprarenal and left gonadal veins
Left kidney is preferred in living donation - longer renal vein
Variant: retroaortic left renal vein passes behind the aorta
postlar.izoh:
🩵 Buyrak venalari pastki kovak venaga (IVC) quyiladi. IVC o'ng tomonda yotgani uchun:
• O'NG buyrak venasi kalta;
• CHAP buyrak venasi UZUN - aortaning OLDIDAN, AMS ning orqasidan (ular orasidagi burchakdan) o'tadi.

➕ Chap buyrak venasi qo'shimcha 2 ta venani qabul qiladi:
• chap buyrak usti bezi venasi (v. suprarenalis sinistra);
• chap moyak/tuxumdon venasi (v. testicularis/ovarica sinistra).
O'ngda bu venalar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri IVC ga quyiladi.

🎁 Tirik donordan buyrak olishda ko'pincha CHAP buyrak tanlanadi - uning venasi uzunroq, retsipient tomirlariga tikish (anastomoz) osonroq.

🔄 Variant: retroaortal chap buyrak venasi - aortaning ORQASIDAN o'tadi (jarrohlikda e'tibor kerak).

💡 USMLE: chap buyrak venasining siqilishi yoki o'sma bilan berkilishi -> CHAP varikotsele (chap moyak venasi unga quyilgani uchun). Rasmda (Spalteholz) aorta, IVC, buyrak venalari va buyrak usti bezlari.

postlar.sarlavha: Renal blood flow: cortex vs medulla
bandlar: Kidneys receive ~20-25% of cardiac output
Most of the flow goes to the cortex; the medulla gets much less
Medulla is very sensitive to hypoxia and ischemic injury
Vulnerable: proximal straight tubule and thick ascending limb
postlar.izoh:
🩸 Buyraklar yurak minutlik hajmining taxminan 20-25% ini oladi - og'irligiga nisbatan eng ko'p qon oladigan a'zolardan.

🔹 PO'STLOQ (cortex) - qonning asosiy qismini oladi (glomerulalar shu yerda).
🔸 MAG'IZ (medulla, piramidalar) - qon oqimi ancha KAM. Bu siydikni konsentratsiyalash (qarama-qarshi oqim tizimi) uchun zarur, lekin narxi bor:
• mag'iz doimo nisbiy GIPOKSIYADA ishlaydi;
• ayniqsa proksimal kanalchaning to'g'ri qismi (S3) va Henle qovuzlog'ining yo'g'on ko'tariluvchi qismi (TAL) ko'p ATP sarflaydi.

⚠️ Natijasi: gipotenziya, shok, sepsis -> o'tkir tubulyar nekroz (ATN) birinchi navbatda shu sohalarda.
Buyrak so'rg'ichlari (papillae) ham ishemiyaga sezgir - so'rg'ich nekrozi: NSAID, o'roqsimon hujayrali kasallik, qandli diabet, og'ir pielonefrit.

Rasmda (Sobotta) buyrakning frontal kesimi: substantia corticalis, piramidalar (substantia medullaris), papillae, calices va pelvis renalis.

bandlar: Afferent arteriole enters and efferent leaves at the vascular pole
Bowman capsule: parietal layer outside, podocytes (visceral) inside
Mesangial cells: support, contraction, phagocytosis
Urinary pole opens into the proximal convoluted tubule
postlar.izoh:
🔬 Buyrak tanachasi (corpusculum renale) = kapillyar koptokcha (glomerulus) + Bowman kapsulasi.

🔴 Tomir qutbi:
• AFFERENT (olib keluvchi) arteriola - kengroq, qonni kapillyarlarga olib kiradi;
• EFFERENT (olib chiquvchi) arteriola - torroq, qonni olib chiqadi -> peritubulyar kapillyarlar (yukstamedullyar nefronlarda vasa recta).
Ikki arteriola orasidagi yuqori bosim filtratsiyani ta'minlaydi.

🟡 Bowman kapsulasi:
• PARIYETAL varaq - yassi epiteliy (tashqi devor);
• VISSERAL varaq - PODOTSITLAR, kapillyarlarni o'rab turadi;
• oradagi Bowman bo'shlig'iga birlamchi siydik (filtrat) tushadi.

🟣 MEZANGIAL hujayralar - kapillyarlar orasida: tayanch, qisqarish (filtratsiya yuzasini boshqaradi), fagotsitoz.

🚪 Siydik qutbi -> proksimal egri kanalcha.

💡 USMLE: IgA nefropatiyada immun komplekslar aynan MEZANGIYDA to'planadi.

bandlar: JGA = JG cells + macula densa + extraglomerular mesangial cells
JG cells: modified smooth muscle of afferent arteriole - secrete renin
Macula densa (distal tubule) senses NaCl delivery
High NaCl -> adenosine -> afferent constriction -> GFR falls

bandlar: 1. Fenestrated capillary endothelium - holds back blood cells
2. Glomerular basement membrane - type IV collagen, heparan sulfate (-)
3. Podocyte foot processes with slit diaphragms (nephrin)
Negative charge repels albumin; loss -> proteinuria
postlar.izoh:
🧱 Filtratsiya to'sig'i 3 qavatdan iborat (qondan Bowman bo'shlig'iga qarab):

1️⃣ TESHIKLI (fenestrlangan) kapillyar endoteliysi - qon hujayralarini o'tkazmaydi.

2️⃣ GLOMERULYAR BAZAL MEMBRANA (GBM) - IV tip kollagen, laminin va GEPARAN SULFAT. Geparan sulfat MANFIY zaryadli -> manfiy zaryadli albuminni itaradi (zaryad to'sig'i).

3️⃣ PODOTSITLAR - oyoqchalari (foot processes) orasida yupqa TIRQISH DIAFRAGMASI (asosiy oqsili - NEFRIN) - o'lcham to'sig'i.

✅ O'tadi: suv, ionlar, glyukoza, aminokislotalar, mochevina, kreatinin.
❌ O'tmaydi: hujayralar, yirik oqsillar (albumin deyarli o'tmaydi).

⚠️ Klinika:
• zaryad to'sig'i yoki podotsitlar shikastlansa -> NEFROTIK sindrom (kuchli proteinuriya); minimal o'zgarishli kasallikda podotsit oyoqchalari "yassilanadi";
• nefrin geni mutatsiyasi -> tug'ma nefrotik sindrom;
• IV tip kollagen nuqsoni -> Alport sindromi (gematuriya + karlik).

The two tissues induce each other

bandlar: FF = GFR / RPF; normal about 20%
Filtered load (mg/min) = GFR (mL/min) x plasma conc. (mg/mL)
GFR is estimated with creatinine clearance (inulin is exact)
RPF is best estimated with PAH clearance
postlar.izoh:
🧮 Filtratsiya bo'yicha asosiy formulalar:

1️⃣ FILTRATSIYA FRAKSIYASI (FF) = GFR / RPF
• buyrakka kelgan PLAZMANING qancha qismi filtrlanishini ko'rsatadi;
• normada ~20% (masalan, GFR 120 mL/min, RPF 600 mL/min -> FF = 0,2).

2️⃣ FILTRLANGAN YUK (filtered load) = GFR (mL/min) x moddaning plazmadagi konsentratsiyasi (mg/mL) -> mg/min.
Masalan: GFR 125 mL/min, glyukoza 1 mg/mL -> 125 mg/min.

3️⃣ GFR qanday baholanadi:
• KREATININ klirensi - amaliyotda ishlatiladi; kreatinin biroz sekretsiya ham qilingani uchun GFR ni sal OSHIRIB ko'rsatadi;
• inulin - erkin filtrlanadi, qayta so'rilmaydi va sekretsiya qilinmaydi -> eng aniq o'lchov.

4️⃣ RPF - PAH (para-aminogippur kislota) klirensi bilan eng yaxshi baholanadi: PAH ham filtrlanadi, ham deyarli to'liq SEKRETSIYA qilinadi, shuning uchun buyrakdan bir o'tishda plazmadan deyarli butunlay tozalanadi.

💡 USMLE: FF oshishi -> peritubulyar kapillyarlarda onkotik bosim oshadi -> proksimal reabsorbsiya kuchayadi.

bandlar: Prostaglandins (PGE2, PGI2) dilate the afferent arteriole
Keep GFR and RPF up when renal perfusion is low
NSAIDs block COX -> afferent constriction -> GFR and RPF fall
Risk of AKI: NSAID + hypovolemia or ACE inhibitor + diuretic
postlar.izoh:
🧠 Eslab qolish: "PDA" - Prostaglandins Dilate Afferent arteriole.

🔹 Buyrak prostaglandinlari (PGE2, PGI2) AFFERENT arteriolani KENGAYTIRADI:
• glomerulaga ko'proq qon keladi -> GFR va RPF ko'tariladi;
• bu, ayniqsa, buyrak perfuziyasi kamayganda (gipovolemiya, yurak yetishmovchiligi, sirroz) himoya mexanizmi.

🔸 NSAID (ibuprofen, diklofenak va b.) COX ni to'sadi -> prostaglandinlar kamayadi -> afferent arteriola QISQARADI:
• GFR pasayadi, RPF pasayadi;
• FF o'zgarmaydi (ikkalasi ham kamaygani uchun).

⚠️ Xavfli kombinatsiya ("uchlik zarba"): NSAID + ACE ingibitori/ARB + diuretik -> o'tkir buyrak shikastlanishi (AKI), ayniqsa keksalarda va suvsizlanganda.

💡 USMLE: diareya bilan suvsizlangan bemor bosh og'rig'iga ibuprofen ichdi va kreatinini oshdi -> mexanizm: afferent arteriolaning prostaglandin bilan kengayishi yo'qoldi.

Middle: gonadal artery, aorta, common and internal iliac arteries
Distal: internal iliac and superior vesical arteries
Abdominal part fed from medial side, pelvic part from lateral side
postlar.izoh:
🩸 Siydik yo'li uzun naycha bo'lgani uchun qonni BIR NECHTA manbadan, yo'l-yo'lakay oladi:

1️⃣ PROKSIMAL (yuqori) qism - buyrak arteriyalari (a. renalis).

2️⃣ O'RTA qism - moyak/tuxumdon arteriyasi, qorin aortasi, umumiy va ichki yonbosh arteriyalari.

3️⃣ DISTAL (chanoq) qism - ichki yonbosh arteriyasi va qovuqning yuqori arteriyasi (a. vesicalis superior); ayollarda bachadon arteriyasidan ham tarmoqlar.

Bu tarmoqlar siydik yo'li devori bo'ylab uzunasiga anastomoz hosil qiladi.

🔪 Jarrohlik qoidasi:
• qorin qismida tarmoqlar siydik yo'liga MEDIAL tomondan keladi;
• chanoq qismida - LATERAL tomondan.
Shuning uchun siydik yo'lini ajratishda tomirlar kelmaydigan tomondan ishlash kerak.

⚠️ Siydik yo'lini atrofidagi to'qimadan haddan ortiq "tozalash" (skeletlash) uning qon ta'minotini buzadi -> ishemiya, striktura yoki oqma.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: 1. Ureteropelvic junction (UPJ)
2. Pelvic inlet, where the ureter crosses the iliac vessels
3. Ureterovesical junction (UVJ) - the narrowest point
Colicky flank-to-groin pain; noncontrast CT is the best test
postlar.izoh:
🪨 Siydik yo'lining 3 ta fiziologik torayishi bor - buyrak toshlari aynan shu joylarda tiqilib qoladi:

1️⃣ Jom-siydik yo'li tutashuvi (UPJ) - jom siydik yo'liga o'tgan joy.
2️⃣ Kichik chanoq kirish chizig'i (pelvic inlet) - siydik yo'li yonbosh tomirlar ustidan kesib o'tgan joy.
3️⃣ Siydik yo'li-qovuq tutashuvi (UVJ) - qovuq devori ichidan o'tadigan qism; ENG TOR joy, toshlar eng ko'p shu yerda to'xtaydi.

🩺 Klinika (buyrak sanchig'i):
• to'lqinsimon, juda kuchli og'riq - beldan (yon) chov va jinsiy a'zolarga tarqaladi ("loin to groin") - og'riq T11-L2 segmentlariga beriladi;
• bemor bezovta, bir joyda tura olmaydi; ko'ngil aynishi, gematuriya;
• UVJ da tosh -> tez-tez siyish, siyishga chaqiriq.

🔎 Tashxis: kontrastsiz spiral KT - eng yaxshi usul; homiladorlar va bolalarda - UZI. Rentgenda (KUB) kalsiyli toshlar ko'rinadi.

💡 Toshning siydik yo'lidagi joyi KT da umurtqa sathiga qarab aniqlanadi.

bandlar: Ureter passes obliquely through the bladder wall
Bladder contraction compresses the intramural segment
This flap-valve prevents vesicoureteral reflux
Short intramural tunnel -> VUR, recurrent UTIs in children

Apex -> median umbilical ligament (urachus remnant)
Trigone: smooth area between ureteric and internal urethral orifices
Rest of the mucosa forms rugae when the bladder is empty

bandlar: Smooth muscle forming most of the bladder wall
Interlacing inner longitudinal, middle circular, outer longitudinal layers
Contracts to empty the bladder (micturition)
Controlled by parasympathetic pelvic splanchnic nerves S2-S4 (M3)

bandlar: Smooth muscle around the bladder neck (sphincter vesicae)
Involuntary - sympathetic fibers T11-L2 (alpha-1 receptors)
Contracts during the filling phase to prevent leakage
In men: also closes during ejaculation (prevents retrograde flow)

bandlar: Skeletal muscle of the urogenital diaphragm surrounding the urethra
Voluntary - perineal branches of the pudendal nerve (S2-S4)
Relaxes during micturition; contracts to hold urine
Pudendal nerve: around the ischial spine (landmark for nerve block)

bandlar: Preganglionic fibers from sacral segments S2, S3, S4
Travel in pelvic splanchnic nerves to the detrusor
ACh on M3 receptors -> detrusor contraction -> voiding
Parasympathetics facilitate micturition

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Fibers from T11-L2 via lumbar splanchnic nerves
Reach the bladder through the hypogastric (pelvic) plexus
Supply the trigone and internal urethral sphincter (alpha-1)
Beta-3 relaxes the detrusor; sympathetics inhibit micturition
postlar.izoh:
🔴 Simpatik innervatsiya - siydikni YIG'ISH va USHLAB TURISHNI ta'minlaydi (siyishni to'xtatadi).

📍 Yo'li:
• preganglionar neyronlar T11-L2 segmentlarida (darsda L1-L2 deb ham berilgan);
• BEL splanxnik nervlari (nn. splanchnici lumbales) -> pastki tutqich ganglionlari -> yuqori gipogastral chigal -> gipogastral nervlar -> pastki gipogastral (tos) chigal -> qovuq chigali (plexus vesicalis).

⚙️ Ta'siri (noradrenalin):
• alfa-1 retseptorlar -> TRIGON va ICHKI sfinkter qisqaradi (qovuq bo'yni yopiladi);
• beta-3 retseptorlar -> DETRUZOR bo'shashadi (qovuq ko'p siydikni past bosimda yig'adi).

📌 Qoida: simpatik faollashuv -> siydik TUTILISHI; parasimpatik faollashuv -> siydik CHIQISHI.

💡 USMLE: mirabegron - beta-3 agonist, haddan faol qovuqda detruzorni bo'shashtiradi; amfetamin kabi simpatomimetiklar siydik tutilishini kuchaytiradi.

Rasmda (Spalteholz) tos vegetativ chigallari: truncus sympathicus, plexus hypogastricus, plexus vesicalis, nn. vesicales.

postlar.sarlavha: Bladder: blood supply, veins and lymph
bandlar: Arteries: vesical branches of the internal iliac artery
Superior vesical arteries from the patent part of the umbilical artery
Vesical venous plexus -> internal iliac veins
Lymph -> external and internal iliac nodes

bandlar: Pontine micturition center coordinates sympathetic and parasympathetic
Frontal cortex gives voluntary (inhibitory) control
Sacral center S2-S4 runs the voiding reflex
Sympathetic -> urinary retention; parasympathetic -> voiding
postlar.izoh:
🧠 Siyish (mikturitsiya) 3 darajada boshqariladi:

1️⃣ BOSH MIYA PO'STLOG'I (peshona bo'lagi medial yuzasi) - ixtiyoriy nazorat: "hozir mumkin emas" deb siyishni to'xtatib turadi, qulay vaqtda ruxsat beradi.

2️⃣ KO'PRIKDAGI SIYISH MARKAZI (pontine micturition center, Barrington yadrosi) - ixtiyorsiz qovuq faoliyatini boshqaradi: simpatik va parasimpatik tizimlarni MUVOFIQLASHTIRADI (detruzor qisqarganda sfinkterlar bo'shashishi kerak).

3️⃣ SAKRAL markaz (S2-S4) - siyish reflektor yoyi: qovuq cho'zilishi haqidagi signal -> parasimpatik javob.

🔄 Bosqichlar:
• TO'LISH: simpatik faol (detruzor bo'shashgan, ichki sfinkter yopiq), n. pudendus tashqi sfinkterni yopiq tutadi;
• SIYISH: ko'prik markazi buyrug'i bilan parasimpatik faollashadi (detruzor qisqaradi), ikkala sfinkter bo'shashadi.

⚠️ Ko'prik va sakral markaz orasidagi orqa miya shikastlanishida muvofiqlik buziladi -> detruzor-sfinkter dissinergiyasi (detruzor qisqarganda sfinkter ham qisqaradi).

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Antimuscarinics (oxybutynin, tolterodine) block M3 - overactive bladder
Mirabegron: beta-3 agonist - relaxes detrusor
Bethanechol: muscarinic agonist - non-obstructive urinary retention
Alpha-1 blockers (tamsulosin) relax bladder neck/prostate - BPH
postlar.izoh:
💊 Ba'zi vegetativ dorilar qovuq silliq mushak retseptorlariga ta'sir qilib, uning faoliyati buzilishini davolaydi:

1️⃣ ANTIMUSKARIN dorilar - oksibutinin, tolterodin, solifenatsin:
• detruzordagi M3 retseptorlarni to'sadi -> detruzor qisqarishi kamayadi;
• haddan tashqari faol qovuq (urge inkontinensiya);
• nojo'ya: og'iz qurishi, qabziyat, keksalarda chalkashlik, yopiq burchakli glaukoma.

2️⃣ MIRABEGRON - beta-3 agonist: detruzorni bo'shashtiradi, qovuq sig'imini oshiradi; antixolinergik nojo'ya ta'sirlari yo'q (lekin qon bosimini oshirishi mumkin).

3️⃣ BETANEXOL - muskarin agonisti: detruzorni qisqartiradi -> operatsiyadan keyingi yoki neyrogen (obstruksiyasiz) siydik tutilishida.

4️⃣ ALFA-1 BLOKATORLAR - tamsulozin, alfuzozin, doksazozin: qovuq bo'yni va prostata silliq mushagini bo'shashtiradi -> BPH da siydik oqimi yaxshilanadi, to'lib oqish inkontinensiyasida obstruksiyani kamaytiradi.

💡 USMLE: siydik tutilishi bor odamga antixolinergik berish xavfli (ayniqsa BPH).

bandlar: Outlet incompetence: urethral hypermobility or intrinsic sphincter deficiency
Leak with increased abdominal pressure: cough, sneeze, lifting
Positive bladder stress test (leak seen on cough/Valsalva)
Tx: Kegel exercises, weight loss, pessary

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Detrusor overactivity - involuntary detrusor contractions
Sudden urge to void, leak before reaching the toilet
Causes: UTI, idiopathic, neurologic disease
Tx: Kegel, bladder training, antimuscarinics, mirabegron; mixed = stress + urge

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Incomplete emptying: detrusor underactivity or outlet obstruction
Leak when the bladder overfills; constant dribbling
High post-void residual on catheter or ultrasound
Tx: catheterization, relieve obstruction (alpha-1 blockers for BPH)

bandlar: Spinal cord lesion ABOVE the sacral segments
Loss of descending inhibition of the parasympathetic (detrusor) reflex
Detrusor contracts with minimal stretch -> small, hyperreflexic bladder
Urge incontinence; may have detrusor-sphincter dyssynergia

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Lesion of sacral cord segments (S2-S4) or sacral nerve roots
Loss of pelvic splanchnic motor supply -> detrusor cannot contract
Large, flaccid, overfilled bladder
Continuous dribbling (overflow incontinence)

savollar.vinyetka: A 42-year-old man has sudden, severe colicky left flank pain radiating to the groin, with nausea and microscopic hematuria. Noncontrast CT shows a 6-mm calcified stone in the left ureter where it crosses the common iliac artery.
savollar.savol: At which ureteral narrowing is the stone lodged?
savollar.izoh: Siydik yo'li umumiy yonbosh arteriyasini kesib o'tgan joy - kichik chanoq kirish chizig'i, 3 ta torayishdan biri (UPJ, chanoq kirishi, UVJ).
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 42 yoshli erkakda to'satdan chap yon sohada chovga tarqaluvchi kuchli sanchiqli og'riq, ko'ngil aynishi va mikrogematuriya paydo bo'ldi. Kontrastsiz KT da chap siydik yo'lida, u umumiy yonbosh arteriyasini kesib o'tgan joyda 6 mm li kalsiyli tosh aniqlandi.
savollar.savol_uz: Tosh siydik yo'lining qaysi torayishida tiqilib qolgan?

savollar.vinyetka: Two days after an abdominal hysterectomy for fibroids, a 46-year-old woman develops right flank pain and fever. Ultrasound shows right hydronephrosis and hydroureter down to the level of the cervix.
savollar.savol: Injury most likely occurred while ligating which structure?
savollar.izoh: Siydik yo'li bachadon bo'yni yonida bachadon arteriyasi OSTIDAN o'tadi ('water under the bridge') - uni bog'lashda ilinib qolishi mumkin.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Mioma sababli qorin orqali gisterektomiyadan 2 kun o'tib 46 yoshli ayolda o'ng yon og'rig'i va isitma paydo bo'ldi. UZI da o'ng tomonlama gidronefroz va bachadon bo'yni sathigacha kengaygan siydik yo'li aniqlandi.
savollar.savol_uz: Shikast qaysi tuzilmani bog'lash paytida yuz bergan bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori?

savollar.vinyetka: A healthy 35-year-old woman volunteers to donate a kidney to her brother. Both kidneys are equal in size and function and each has a single artery. The surgeon plans to remove her left kidney.
savollar.savol: What anatomic feature makes the left kidney preferred?
javoblar: It lies lower than the right
It has no gonadal vein tributary
It lies anterior to the colon
savollar.izoh: Chap buyrak venasi aorta oldidan o'tgani uchun uzun - retsipient tomirlariga tikish oson. O'ng buyrak arteriyasi aslida uzunroq.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Sog'lom 35 yoshli ayol akasiga buyrak berishga rozi bo'ldi. Ikkala buyrak o'lchami va faoliyati bir xil, har birida bitta arteriya bor. Jarroh chap buyrakni olishni rejalashtirdi.
savollar.savol_uz: Chap buyrakni afzal qiladigan anatomik xususiyat qaysi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 29-year-old woman has blood pressure of 178/108 mm Hg despite two drugs. She does not smoke and has normal lipids. A bruit is heard in the right upper abdomen. Angiography shows alternating narrowing and dilation of the distal right renal artery.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely diagnosis?
savollar.izoh: Yosh ayol + distal 2/3 qismda 'marjon shodasi' ko'rinishi -> fibromuskulyar displaziya. Ateroskleroz proksimal 1/3 da, keksa erkaklarda.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 29 yoshli ayolning qon bosimi ikki dori qabul qilishiga qaramay 178/108 mm sim. ust. Chekmaydi, lipidlari normal. Qorinning o'ng yuqori qismida shovqin eshitiladi. Angiografiyada o'ng buyrak arteriyasining distal qismida torayish va kengayishlar navbatlashadi.
savollar.savol_uz: Eng ehtimolli tashxis qaysi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 70-year-old male smoker with coronary and peripheral artery disease has resistant hypertension. One week after starting lisinopril, his serum creatinine rises from 1.1 to 2.6 mg/dL. Imaging shows bilateral renal artery stenosis.
savollar.savol: What best explains the fall in GFR?
savollar.izoh: Ikki tomonlama RAS da GFR angiotenzin II ning efferentni toraytirishiga bog'liq. ACEi efferentni kengaytiradi -> glomerulyar bosim tushadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Koronar va periferik arteriyalar kasalligi bor 70 yoshli chekuvchi erkakda rezistent gipertenziya. Lizinopril boshlanganidan bir hafta o'tib qon kreatinini 1,1 dan 2,6 mg/dL ga oshdi. Tekshiruvda ikki tomonlama buyrak arteriyasi stenozi aniqlandi.
savollar.savol_uz: GFR pasayishini eng yaxshi nima tushuntiradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 66-year-old man with severe diarrhea for 3 days takes ibuprofen several times daily for a headache. His creatinine rises from 0.9 to 2.1 mg/dL. Urinalysis is bland.
savollar.savol: Which change in renal hemodynamics best explains this?
savollar.izoh: PDA: prostaglandinlar afferentni kengaytiradi. NSAID ularni to'sadi -> gipovolemiyada afferent qisqaradi -> GFR va RPF tushadi, FF o'zgarmaydi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 3 kundan beri kuchli diareya bilan og'rigan 66 yoshli erkak bosh og'rig'i uchun kuniga bir necha marta ibuprofen ichgan. Kreatinini 0,9 dan 2,1 mg/dL ga oshdi. Siydik tahlilida o'zgarish yo'q.
savollar.savol_uz: Buyrak gemodinamikasidagi qaysi o'zgarish buni eng yaxshi tushuntiradi?

savollar.vinyetka: In an experiment, a drug selectively constricts the efferent arterioles of the kidney while systemic blood pressure stays constant.
savollar.savol: Which set of changes is expected?
javoblar: GFR up, RPF down, FF up
GFR down, RPF down, FF same
GFR up, RPF up, FF same
GFR down, RPF up, FF down
GFR same, RPF same, FF same
savollar.izoh: ACE qoidasi: efferent torayishi glomerulyar bosimni oshiradi (GFR oshadi), plazma oqimi kamayadi (RPF), FF = GFR/RPF oshadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Tajribada dori buyrakning efferent arteriolalarini tanlab toraytiradi, umumiy qon bosimi esa o'zgarmaydi.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi o'zgarishlar kutiladi?
javoblar_uz: GFR oshadi, RPF kamayadi, FF oshadi
GFR kamayadi, RPF oshadi, FF kamayadi

savollar.vinyetka: A 54-year-old man has hypertension and a right kidney 2 cm shorter than the left on ultrasound. Selective renal vein sampling shows a high renin level from the right renal vein and a suppressed renin level from the left.
savollar.savol: Where is the lesion most likely located?
savollar.izoh: Bir tomonlama RAS: stenozli tomonda renin yuqori, sog' buyrakda bosilgan. O'ng buyrak kichraygan (atrofiya) -> o'ng arteriya stenozi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 54 yoshli erkakda gipertenziya; UZI da o'ng buyrak chapdan 2 sm kalta. Buyrak venalaridan tanlab qon olinganda o'ng buyrak venasida renin yuqori, chapda esa bosilgan.
savollar.savol_uz: Shikast qayerda joylashgan bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori?

savollar.vinyetka: After a prolonged episode of septic shock, a 60-year-old woman becomes oliguric. Urine shows muddy brown granular casts. Biopsy shows necrosis of tubular cells in the outer medulla, while glomeruli look normal.
savollar.savol: Why is this region most affected?
javoblar: It has low blood flow and high O2 use
It receives most of the renal blood flow
It is supplied by the efferent of cortical nephrons only
It is formed from the ureteric bud
savollar.izoh: Mag'iz qonni kam oladi, lekin to'g'ri proksimal kanalcha va TAL ko'p ATP sarflaydi -> ishemiyaga eng sezgir (o'tkir tubulyar nekroz).
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Uzoq davom etgan septik shokdan keyin 60 yoshli ayolda oliguriya rivojlandi. Siydikda loyqa-jigarrang donador silindrlar. Biopsiyada tashqi mag'izdagi kanalcha hujayralari nekrozi, glomerulalar esa normal.
savollar.savol_uz: Nega aynan shu soha ko'proq zararlangan?
javoblar_uz: qon kam keladi, O2 sarfi yuqori

savollar.vinyetka: A newborn has massive proteinuria, edema and hypoalbuminemia from the first week of life. Genetic testing shows a mutation in the gene encoding nephrin.
savollar.savol: Which part of the filtration barrier is defective?
javoblar: Type IV collagen of the GBM
savollar.izoh: Nefrin - podotsit oyoqchalari orasidagi tirqish diafragmasining asosiy oqsili. Mutatsiyasi -> tug'ma nefrotik sindrom.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Yangi tug'ilgan chaqaloqda hayotining birinchi haftasidan kuchli proteinuriya, shishlar va gipoalbuminemiya. Genetik tahlilda nefrin genida mutatsiya aniqlandi.
savollar.savol_uz: Filtratsiya to'sig'ining qaysi qismi nuqsonli?

savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old man with long-standing chronic kidney disease has fatigue. Hemoglobin is 8.9 g/dL with normocytic red cells and a low reticulocyte count. Iron, B12 and folate are normal.
savollar.savol: Which renal cells normally produce the deficient hormone?
savollar.izoh: EPO ni buyrak po'stlog'i va mag'izidagi peritubulyar interstitsial fibroblastlar ishlab chiqaradi; SBK da kamayadi -> normotsitar anemiya.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Uzoq yillik surunkali buyrak kasalligi bor 58 yoshli erkak holsizlikdan shikoyat qiladi. Gemoglobin 8,9 g/dL, eritrotsitlar normotsitar, retikulotsitlar kam. Temir, B12 va folat normal.
savollar.savol_uz: Yetishmayotgan gormonni odatda buyrakning qaysi hujayralari ishlab chiqaradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 4-year-old girl has had three febrile urinary tract infections in one year. Voiding cystourethrography shows contrast flowing from the bladder up into the left ureter and renal pelvis during voiding.
savollar.savol: Failure of which mechanism most likely explains this?
javoblar: Compression of the oblique intramural ureter
Contraction of the external urethral sphincter
Ureteral peristalsis from the renal pelvis
Closure of the internal urethral sphincter
savollar.izoh: Siydik yo'lining qovuq devori ichidan qiya o'tgan qismi qovuq qisqarganda siqilib, reflyuksni to'sadi. Kalta bo'lsa -> VUR.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 4 yoshli qizda bir yil ichida isitmali siydik yo'li infeksiyasi 3 marta takrorlandi. Mikstsion sistouretrografiyada siyish paytida kontrast qovuqdan chap siydik yo'li va jomga ko'tarilayotgani ko'rindi.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi mexanizm ishlamasligi buni eng yaxshi tushuntiradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 38-year-old woman with three vaginal deliveries leaks small amounts of urine when she coughs, laughs or lifts her child. She has no urge to void before leaking. Leakage is seen from the urethra during a cough test.
savollar.savol: What is the best initial treatment?
savollar.izoh: Stress inkontinensiya (tug'ruqlar, yo'talda oqish, stress testi musbat). Birinchi qadam - Kegel mashqlari, vazn kamaytirish, pessariy.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 3 marta tabiiy yo'l bilan tug'gan 38 yoshli ayol yo'talganda, kulganda yoki bolasini ko'targanda oz miqdorda siydik oqib ketishidan shikoyat qiladi. Oqishdan oldin siyish istagi bo'lmaydi. Yo'tal testida siydik kanalidan oqish ko'rindi.
savollar.savol_uz: Eng yaxshi boshlang'ich davo qaysi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 72-year-old woman reports sudden strong urges to urinate and often leaks before reaching the toilet, many times a day and at night. Urinalysis is normal and post-void residual is low. Bladder training has not helped.
savollar.savol: The most appropriate drug acts by which mechanism?
javoblar: Blocks alpha-1 receptors at bladder neck
savollar.izoh: Urge inkontinensiya - detruzor haddan faol. Oksibutinin kabi antimuskarinlar detruzordagi M3 ni to'sadi (yoki mirabegron - beta-3 agonist).
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 72 yoshli ayol kuniga ko'p marta va kechasi to'satdan kuchli siyish istagi paydo bo'lishi va ko'pincha hojatxonaga yetmasdan siydik oqib ketishidan shikoyat qiladi. Siydik tahlili normal, qoldiq siydik kam. Qovuqni mashq qildirish yordam bermadi.
savollar.savol_uz: Eng mos dori qaysi mexanizm orqali ta'sir qiladi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 74-year-old man has weak stream, a feeling of incomplete emptying and constant dribbling of urine. The bladder is palpable above the pubis. Digital rectal exam shows a smooth, enlarged prostate. Post-void residual is 600 mL.
savollar.savol: Besides catheterization, which drug best relieves the cause?
savollar.izoh: BPH tufayli to'lib oqish inkontinensiyasi (qoldiq siydik yuqori). Alfa-1 blokator qovuq bo'yni va prostatani bo'shashtirib obstruksiyani kamaytiradi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 74 yoshli erkakda siydik oqimi sust, to'liq bo'shamaganlik hissi va doimiy tomchilab siydik oqishi bor. Qov ustida qovuq paypaslanadi. To'g'ri ichak orqali tekshiruvda prostata silliq, kattalashgan. Siyishdan keyingi qoldiq 600 mL.
savollar.savol_uz: Kateterizatsiyadan tashqari qaysi dori sababni eng yaxshi bartaraf etadi?

savollar.vinyetka: Eight months after a complete spinal cord injury at T6, a 27-year-old man has frequent small-volume involuntary voiding. Urodynamics show detrusor contractions at very low bladder volumes and a small, thick-walled bladder.
savollar.savol: What best explains this bladder dysfunction?
javoblar: Loss of pelvic splanchnic motor fibers
savollar.izoh: Sakraldan yuqori shikast -> spastik qovuq: sakral refleks butun, lekin yuqoridan tormozlash yo'q -> detruzor oz cho'zilishda qisqaradi (urge).

xulosa: Buyraklar T12-L3 sathida, o'ng buyrak jigar tufayli pastroq; chap buyrak 11-12-, o'ng buyrak 12-qovurg'aga tegadi.
Chap buyrak venasi uzun, aorta oldidan o'tadi va chap buyrak usti hamda chap jinsiy bez venalarini qabul qiladi - donorlikda chap buyrak olinadi.
Buyrak mag'izi kam qon oladi - ishemiyaga (ATN, so'rg'ich nekrozi) eng sezgir.
Filtratsiya to'sig'i: teshikli endoteliy, manfiy zaryadli GBM, podotsit tirqish diafragmasi (nefrin).
FF = GFR/RPF (~20%); filtrlangan yuk = GFR x plazma konsentratsiyasi; GFR - kreatinin, RPF - PAH klirensi.
PDA: prostaglandinlar afferentni kengaytiradi (NSAID xavfi); ACE: angiotenzin II efferentni toraytiradi.
RAS: ateroskleroz - proksimal 1/3, keksa erkaklar; FMD - distal 2/3, yosh ayollar; ikki tomonlamada ACEi kreatininni oshiradi.
Siydik yo'li yonbosh tomirlar USTIDAN, bachadon arteriyasi/urug' yo'li OSTIDAN o'tadi; 3 torayishi - UPJ, chanoq kirishi, UVJ.
Detruzor - parasimpatik S2-S4 (siyish); ichki sfinkter - simpatik T11-L2 (ushlab turish); tashqi sfinkter - n. pudendus (ixtiyoriy).
Inkontinensiya: stress - chiqish yetishmovchiligi; urge - detruzor faolligi; overflow - to'liq bo'shamaslik; spastik qovuq - urge, atonik - overflow.

🩸 Tuxumdon IKKI manbadan qon oladi:

1️⃣ Tuxumdon arteriyasi (a. ovarica):
• qorin AORTASIDAN to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chiqadi (buyrak arteriyalaridan sal pastda, ~L2);
• chanoqqa infundibulopelvik (osib turuvchi) boylam ichida tushadi.

2️⃣ Bachadon arteriyasining ko'tariluvchi tarmoqlari:
• a. uterina ichki yonbosh arteriyasidan (a. iliaca interna) chiqadi;
• bachadonning yon qirrasi bo'ylab yuqoriga ko'tarilib, tuxumdon (ramus ovarii) va nay (ramus tubarius) tarmoqlarini beradi.

🔗 Ikkala tizim keng boylam ichida anastomoz hosil qiladi - shuning uchun bachadon arteriyasi bog'langanda ham tuxumdon qonsiz qolmaydi.

💡 USMLE: gonadalar qorin orqa devorida (buyrak yonida) rivojlanib, pastga tushgani uchun ularning arteriyasi aortadan, limfasi esa paraaortal tugunlarga boradi. Rasmda (Spalteholz) a. ovarica, a. uterina, ramus ovarii va ureter.

postlar.izoh:
🩵 Venalari - ASSIMETRIK:
• O'NG tuxumdon venasi -> to'g'ridan-to'g'ri pastki kovak venaga (VCI);
• CHAP tuxumdon venasi -> chap buyrak venasiga (to'g'ri burchak ostida), u esa aorta oldidan o'tib VCI ga quyiladi.

🟢 Limfasi: tuxumdon arteriyasi bo'ylab yuqoriga ko'tarilib, aorta yonidagi (lateral aortal, paraaortal) limfa tugunlariga quyiladi.

⚠️ Nima uchun muhim:
• tuxumdon saratoni avval paraaortal tugunlarga tarqaladi - chov tugunlari kattalashmaydi;
• chap buyrak venasi bosilsa yoki trombozga uchrasa (masalan, chap buyrak o'smasi), chap tuxumdon venasida turg'unlik, chanoq varikozi va og'riq paydo bo'lishi mumkin.

💡 Qoida: gonadalar (tuxumdon va moyak) limfasi - PARAAORTAL tugunlarga; bachadon tanasi, bo'yni va qin - boshqa tugunlarga (8-darsdagi jadvalga qarang).

postlar.izoh:
🌸 Estrogenlarning uch turi va manbai:

1️⃣ ESTRADIOL (E2) - eng KUCHLI:
• tuxumdonda (ikkala tuxumdondan) ishlab chiqariladi;
• teka hujayralari LH ta'sirida androgen hosil qiladi, granulyoza hujayralari FSH ta'sirida aromataza yordamida uni estradiolga aylantiradi ("ikki hujayra - ikki gonadotropin").

2️⃣ ESTRON (E1) - o'rtacha:
• yog' to'qimasida androgenlarning (androstenedion) AROMATIZATSIYASI natijasida hosil bo'ladi;
• menopauzadan keyin asosiy estrogen - semizlikda ko'p.

3️⃣ ESTRIOL (E3) - eng KUCHSIZ:
• asosan PLATSENTADA hosil bo'ladi.

📊 Kuchi: estradiol > estron > estriol.

🧬 Estrogen retseptorlari sitoplazmada joylashadi; gormon bog'langach kompleks yadroga o'tib, genlar transkripsiyasini o'zgartiradi.

💡 USMLE: semiz ayolda menopauzadan keyin yog' to'qimasidagi estron endometriyni progesteronsiz rag'batlantiradi -> endometriy giperplaziyasi va saratoni xavfi.

🔄 Vazifalari:
• tuxumdondan chiqqan oositni (urug'langan yoki urug'lanmagan) bachadon bo'shlig'iga olib boradi;
• buning uchun KIPRIKCHALAR harakati va silliq mushak qisqarishlari (peristaltika) ishlaydi;

📌 Nay keng boylamning yuqori erkin qirrasidagi burma - MEZOSALPINKS ichida osilib turadi.

🔬 Shilliq qavati - bir qavatli kiprikli silindrsimon epiteliy.

⚠️ Klinik ahamiyati: kiprikchalar shikastlansa (xlamidiya, gonoreya - PID, chandiqlar) yoki harakatsiz bo'lsa (Kartagener sindromi), embrion bachadonga yetib bora olmaydi -> EKTOPIK homiladorlik va bepushtlik xavfi oshadi.

✂️ Istmus - bachadon tanasi bilan bo'yni o'rtasidagi tor qism. Homiladorlikning ikkinchi yarmida u cho'zilib, yupqa "PASTKI SEGMENT"ni hosil qiladi.

• mushagi qalin, faol qisqaradi - homilani itaradi.

🔹 Pastki segment (istmusdan):
• yupqa, kam qisqaradi, qon tomirlari kamroq.

🏥 Kesar kesish (sectio caesarea) uchun eng qulay joy - ISTMUS (pastki segmentda ko'ndalang kesma):
• qon yo'qotish kamroq;
• chandiq mustahkam bo'ladi;
• keyingi homiladorlikda bachadon YORILISHI xavfi past (vertikal "klassik" kesmaga nisbatan);
• keyingi tug'ruqni qin orqali sinab ko'rish (TOLAC/VBAC) mumkin bo'ladi.

💡 USMLE: oldingi kesar kesish chandig'i - platsentaning chuqur o'sib kirishi (placenta accreta) uchun asosiy xavf omili, ayniqsa platsenta oldinda (previa) joylashsa.

📐 Bachadonning normal holati - ANTEFLEKSIYA va ANTEVERSIYA.

🔹 Antefleksiya - bachadon TANASI bilan BO'YNI orasidagi oldinga qaragan burchak (tana oldinga egilgan).

🔹 Anteversiya - bachadon BO'YNI bilan QIN orasidagi oldinga qaragan burchak (butun bachadon oldinga og'gan).

➡️ Natijada bachadon deyarli GORIZONTAL holatda, siydik pufagining yuqori yuzasida yotadi. Pufak to'lsa, bachadon orqaga ko'tariladi.

🔄 Variantlar: retroversiya/retrofleksiya (bachadon orqaga og'gan) ayollarning ~20% ida uchraydi; odatda belgisiz, ba'zan dismenoreya, bel og'rig'i yoki dispareuniya beradi.

🕳 Atrofidagi chuqurliklar:
• oldinda - pufak-bachadon chuqurchasi (excavatio vesicouterina);
• orqada - to'g'ri ichak-bachadon chuqurchasi (Duglas bo'shlig'i) - tik turgan ayolda qorin bo'shlig'ining eng past nuqtasi, suyuqlik/qon shu yerga yig'iladi (orqa gumbaz orqali punksiya - kuldotsentez).

💡 Rasmda (Spalteholz) ayol chanog'ining median kesimi.

🟤 Bachadon miomasi (leiomioma, fibroid) - bachadon silliq mushak hujayralarining XAVFSIZ (benign) o'smasi. Ayollarda eng ko'p uchraydigan o'sma; ko'pincha ko'p sonli.

📍 Joylashuviga ko'ra 3 turi:

1️⃣ INTRAMURAL - miometriy ichida (eng ko'p).

2️⃣ SUBMUKOZ - endometriy ostida, bachadon bo'shlig'iga bo'rtib o'sadi:
• eng ko'p QON KETISHI (menorragiya) va BEPUSHTLIK beradi;
• implantatsiyaga xalaqit beradi.

3️⃣ SUBSEROZ - seroz parda ostida, qorin bo'shlig'iga qarab o'sadi:
• oyoqchali bo'lishi mumkin (buralishi mumkin);
• qo'shni a'zolarni (siydik pufagi, to'g'ri ichak) bosib, bosim belgilarini beradi.

🔬 Kesimda: oq-kulrang, burama ("whorled") naqshli, aniq chegarali tugunlar. Kalsifikatsiyalanishi mumkin.

💡 USMLE: miomaga xavfli o'zgarish (leiomiosarkoma) DEYARLI xos emas - sarkoma odatda yangi (de novo) paydo bo'ladi.

postlar.izoh:
🎗 Bachadon bo'yni yassi hujayrali saratoni:

📍 Joyi: TRANSFORMATSIYA ZONASI.

🦠 Sababi: odam papilloma virusi (HPV) - ayniqsa yuqori xavfli 16 va 18 tiplar:
• E6 oqsili -> p53 ni parchalaydi;
• E7 oqsili -> Rb ni faolsizlantiradi.

🔄 Bosqichlari: saratondan oldin epiteliy ichida o'zgarishlar - servikal intraepitelial neoplaziya (CIN 1 -> 2 -> 3) -> invaziv saraton. CIN Pap-test (sitologiya) bilan aniqlanadi; HPV testi ham qo'shib tekshiriladi.

⚠️ Asorati: o'sma chanoqning YON DEVORIGA (parametriy) tarqaladi -> siydik yo'llari (ureter) bosiladi -> GIDRONEFROZ -> buyrak yetishmovchiligi (uremiya) - o'limning asosiy sabablaridan biri.

🛡 Xavf omillari: ko'p jinsiy sheriklar, erta jinsiy hayot, chekish, immunitet tanqisligi (OITS).

💡 USMLE: oldini olish - HPV vaksinasi va muntazam skrining. Ikki tomonlama gidronefrozli bemorda bachadon bo'yni saratonini o'ylang.

postlar.izoh:
🔬 Ayol jinsiy a'zolari epiteliysi (tashqaridan ichkariga):

• VULVA - ko'p qavatli yassi epiteliy (muguzlanadi).
• QIN - ko'p qavatli yassi MUGUZLANMAYDIGAN epiteliy.
• EKTOSERVIKS - ko'p qavatli yassi muguzlanmaydigan epiteliy.
• TRANSFORMATSIYA ZONASI - skvamokolumnar chegara: bo'yin saratonining eng ko'p joyi, Pap-test shu yerdan olinadi.
• ENDOSERVIKS - bir qavatli silindrsimon epiteliy.
• BACHADON (endometriy) - bir qavatli silindrsimon epiteliy:
  - proliferativ fazada uzun TO'G'RI naysimon bezlar;
  - sekretor fazada BURALGAN (spiral, "arra tishli") bezlar.
• BACHADON NAYI - bir qavatli KIPRIKLI silindrsimon epiteliy.
• TUXUMDON yuzasi - bir qavatli KUBSIMON epiteliy ("germinal epiteliy").

💡 USMLE: qinda bez yo'q - shilliq bo'yin bezlaridan keladi. Qinning yassi epiteliysi o'rnida bez (adenoz) topilsa - ona homiladorlikda DES qabul qilgani (qinning tiniq hujayrali adenokarsinomasi xavfi).

postlar.izoh:
🔗 Infundibulopelvik boylam = tuxumdonni osib turuvchi boylam (lig. suspensorium ovarii):

📌 Bog'laydi: TUXUMDON -> chanoqning YON DEVORI.

🩸 Ichida: tuxumdon arteriyasi va venasi (shuningdek limfa tomirlari va nervlar).

⚠️ Klinik ahamiyati:
• ooforektomiya (tuxumdonni olib tashlash) da tuxumdon tomirlarini bog'lash uchun shu boylam qisqichga olinadi;
• siydik yo'li (ureter) chanoq kirish chizig'ida aynan shu boylamga juda yaqin, uning orqa-medial tomonidan o'tadi -> ehtiyotsiz bog'lashda URETER jarohatlanishi mumkin;
• adneksa buralishida tuxumdon va nay shu boylam (va tuxumdon xususiy boylami) atrofida aylanadi va tomirlar bosiladi.

💡 USMLE juftligi: ooforektomiya -> infundibulopelvik boylam + ureter; gisterektomiya -> kardinal boylam (bachadon arteriyasi) + ureter.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz) ayol chanoq a'zolari yon tomondan: lig. suspensorium ovarii, a. u. v. ovarica, ureter, lig. latum va lig. teres uteri.

savollar.vinyetka: A 52-year-old woman undergoes left oophorectomy for a complex ovarian cyst. Two days later she has left flank pain and fever. CT shows left hydroureteronephrosis with abrupt narrowing of the ureter at the pelvic brim.
savollar.savol: Clamping of which structure most likely caused this injury?
savollar.izoh: Tuxumdon tomirlari infundibulopelvik boylamda; ooforektomiyada uni bog'lashda chanoq kirishida yaqin yotgan ureter jarohatlanadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 52 yoshli ayolga murakkab tuxumdon kistasi sababli chap ooforektomiya qilindi. Ikki kundan so'ng chap bel og'rig'i va isitma paydo bo'ldi. KT da chap gidroureteronefroz va chanoq kirish chizig'ida ureterning keskin torayishi aniqlandi.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi tuzilmani qisish bu jarohatga eng ehtimoliy sabab bo'lgan?

savollar.vinyetka: During an abdominal hysterectomy, the surgeon places a clamp on the uterine vessels about 1.5 cm lateral to the cervix. Postoperatively the patient develops flank pain and a rising creatinine.
savollar.savol: Which structure was most likely injured?
savollar.izoh: Ureter kardinal boylamda bachadon arteriyasi OSTIDAN o'tadi (ko'prik ostida suv). Gisterektomiyada arteriya bilan birga bog'lanishi mumkin.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Qorin orqali gisterektomiya paytida jarroh bachadon tomirlariga bo'yindan ~1,5 sm lateralda qisqich qo'ydi. Operatsiyadan keyin bemorda bel og'rig'i va kreatinin oshishi kuzatildi.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi tuzilma eng ehtimoliy jarohatlangan?

savollar.vinyetka: A 34-year-old woman has sudden severe right lower quadrant pain with nausea and vomiting while exercising. Ultrasound shows a 7-cm enlarged edematous right ovary with a dermoid cyst and markedly reduced Doppler flow.
savollar.savol: Which event occurs first in the pathogenesis of this condition?
savollar.izoh: Adneksa buralishida avval yupqa devorli vena va limfa bosiladi; arteriya oqimi davom etib shish paydo bo'ladi, keyin arteriya ham yopiladi -> nekroz.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 34 yoshli ayolda mashq paytida to'satdan o'ng pastki kvadrantda kuchli og'riq, ko'ngil aynishi va qusish boshlandi. UTT da dermoid kistali, 7 sm gacha kattalashgan, shishgan o'ng tuxumdon va Doppler oqimining keskin kamayishi aniqlandi.
savollar.savol_uz: Bu holat patogenezida birinchi bo'lib nima yuz beradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 62-year-old obese woman with type 2 diabetes has had vaginal bleeding for 1 month. She is nulliparous and took estrogen-only hormone therapy for 8 years after menopause at age 55.
savollar.savol: Which mechanism best explains her most likely diagnosis?
javoblar: Germ cell tumor of the ovary
savollar.izoh: Postmenopauzal qon ketish + semizlik, diabet, nulliparitet, progestinsiz estrogen - endometriy adenokarsinomasi (progesteronsiz estrogen).
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 2-tip qandli diabeti bor 62 yoshli semiz ayolda 1 oydan beri qindan qon ketmoqda. U tug'magan va 55 yoshdagi menopauzadan keyin 8 yil faqat estrogen bilan gormon terapiyasi olgan.
savollar.savol_uz: Eng ehtimoliy tashxisni qaysi mexanizm yaxshiroq tushuntiradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 41-year-old woman has heavy menstrual periods and fatigue. Hemoglobin is 9.2 g/dL. Pelvic exam shows an enlarged, irregular, nodular uterus. Abdominal X-ray shows a popcorn-like calcified pelvic mass left of midline.
savollar.savol: Which statement about this lesion is correct?
javoblar: Grows with estrogen, shrinks after menopause
It is a malignant epithelial tumor
It arises from the transformation zone
savollar.izoh: Bachadon miomasi - silliq mushakning benign o'smasi, estrogenga sezgir: homiladorlikda o'sadi, menopauzadan keyin kichrayadi; kalsifikatsiyasi popkornsimon.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 41 yoshli ayolda hayz qon ketishi kuchli va holsizlik bor. Gemoglobin 9,2 g/dL. Chanoq ko'rigida kattalashgan, notekis, tugunli bachadon. Qorin rentgenida o'rta chiziqdan chapda popkornsimon kalsifikatsiyalangan massa.
savollar.savol_uz: Bu o'zgarish haqida qaysi fikr to'g'ri?

savollar.vinyetka: A 33-year-old woman with infertility has regular menses. Hysteroscopy shows a 2-cm smooth mass bulging into the endometrial cavity from beneath the endometrium. Biopsy shows benign whorled smooth muscle.
savollar.savol: Which type of lesion is this?
savollar.izoh: Endometriy ostidan bo'shliqqa bo'rtgan mioma - submukoz; u eng ko'p qon ketish va implantatsiya buzilishi (bepushtlik) beradi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Bepushtlikdan aziyat chekayotgan 33 yoshli ayolning hayzi muntazam. Gisteroskopiyada endometriy ostidan bachadon bo'shlig'iga bo'rtib chiqqan 2 sm silliq massa topildi. Biopsiyada burama naqshli benign silliq mushak.
savollar.savol_uz: Bu qaysi turdagi o'zgarish?

savollar.vinyetka: A 45-year-old woman who has never had cervical screening presents with postcoital bleeding and bilateral flank pain. Creatinine is 3.1 mg/dL. Ultrasound shows bilateral hydronephrosis and a friable cervical mass.
savollar.savol: What best explains her renal failure?
savollar.izoh: Bo'yin saratoni chanoq yon devoriga (parametriy) tarqalib, ikkala ureterni bosadi -> gidronefroz va uremiya - asosiy o'lim sababi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Hech qachon bo'yin skriningidan o'tmagan 45 yoshli ayol jinsiy aloqadan keyingi qon ketishi va ikki tomonlama bel og'rig'i bilan keldi. Kreatinin 3,1 mg/dL. UTT da ikki tomonlama gidronefroz va oson qonaydigan bo'yin massasi.
savollar.savol_uz: Buyrak yetishmovchiligini nima yaxshiroq tushuntiradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 27-year-old woman has a Pap smear. The clinician uses a brush and spatula to sample the area where the columnar epithelium of the canal meets the squamous epithelium of the portio vaginalis.
savollar.savol: Why is this area sampled?
javoblar: Ongoing metaplasia - most prone to dysplasia
It is lined by keratinized epithelium
It contains the most cervical glands
It is the site of the internal os
It is lined by ciliated epithelium
savollar.izoh: Transformatsiya zonasida silindrsimon epiteliy doimo yassiga aylanadi (metaplaziya) - HPV va displaziya (CIN) shu yerda boshlanadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 27 yoshli ayoldan Pap-surtma olinmoqda. Shifokor cho'tka va spatula bilan kanalning silindrsimon epiteliysi qin qismining yassi epiteliysi bilan tutashgan sohadan namuna oladi.
savollar.savol_uz: Nega aynan shu soha tekshiriladi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 30-year-old woman is evaluated for infertility. Hysterosalpingography shows a normal triangular uterine cavity and a filled right tube with free intraperitoneal spill, but the left tube is dilated and no contrast spills from it.
savollar.savol: In which part of the tube does fertilization normally occur?
savollar.izoh: Urug'lanish nayning eng uzun va keng qismi - AMPULADA bo'ladi; ektopik homiladorlik ham ko'pincha shu yerda.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 30 yoshli ayol bepushtlik bo'yicha tekshirilmoqda. Gisterosalpingografiyada bachadon bo'shlig'i normal uchburchak, o'ng nay to'lgan va kontrast qorin bo'shlig'iga erkin to'kilgan, chap nay esa kengaygan va undan kontrast to'kilmaydi.
savollar.savol_uz: Nayning qaysi qismida normal urug'lanish yuz beradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 29-year-old woman is tracking her menstrual cycle. On day 21 of a 28-day cycle, her serum progesterone is high and her basal body temperature has risen by 0.4 C compared with the first half of the cycle.
savollar.savol: This finding most strongly indicates which event?
savollar.izoh: Progesteronning oshishi va bazal haroratning ko'tarilishi - sariq tana ishlayotgani, ya'ni ovulyatsiya bo'lganining belgisi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 29 yoshli ayol hayz siklini kuzatmoqda. 28 kunlik siklning 21-kunida qon zardobida progesteron yuqori va bazal harorat siklning birinchi yarmiga nisbatan 0,4 C ga ko'tarilgan.
savollar.savol_uz: Bu natija eng kuchli darajada qaysi hodisani ko'rsatadi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 31-year-old woman delivers a healthy baby. On the second postpartum day milk production begins. Before delivery, despite very high prolactin levels, she produced no milk.
savollar.savol: Which change most directly triggered lactation?
savollar.izoh: Homiladorlikda estrogen va progesteron prolaktinning sut beziga ta'sirini bloklaydi; platsenta chiqqach ular tushadi va laktatsiya boshlanadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 31 yoshli ayol sog'lom chaqaloq tug'di. Tug'ruqdan keyingi ikkinchi kuni sut kela boshladi. Tug'ruqdan oldin prolaktin juda yuqori bo'lsa ham sut chiqmagan.
savollar.savol_uz: Laktatsiyani bevosita qaysi o'zgarish boshlab berdi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 32-year-old woman at 34 weeks of gestation has decreasing fetal movements. Her serum and urinary estriol levels have fallen markedly over two weeks.
savollar.savol: Estriol synthesis requires which combination?
javoblar: Fetal adrenal, fetal liver and placenta
savollar.izoh: Estriol: homila buyrak usti bezi (DHEA-S) -> homila jigari (16-OH) -> platsenta (aromataza). Past estriol - homila yoki platsenta muammosi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Homiladorligi 34 haftalik 32 yoshli ayolda homila harakati kamaygan. Ikki hafta ichida uning qon va siydigidagi estriol keskin kamaygan.
savollar.savol_uz: Estriol sintezi uchun qaysi birikma zarur?
javoblar_uz: homila buyrak usti bezi, jigari va platsenta
sariq tana va ona buyrak usti bezi

savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old obese postmenopausal woman has never taken hormone therapy. Her serum estrogen is mainly estrone, which is elevated compared with lean women of the same age.
savollar.savol: Where is most of her estrone produced?
savollar.izoh: Menopauzadan keyin asosiy estrogen - estron; u yog' to'qimasida androgenlardan aromataza yordamida hosil bo'ladi, semizlikda ko'payadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 58 yoshli semiz, menopauzadagi ayol hech qachon gormon terapiyasi olmagan. Qonidagi estrogen asosan estron bo'lib, u shu yoshdagi ozg'in ayollarnikidan yuqori.
savollar.savol_uz: Estronning asosiy qismi qayerda hosil bo'ladi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 67-year-old woman with 5 vaginal deliveries has a sensation of pelvic pressure and a bulge at the introitus that worsens with straining, plus urinary frequency. Exam shows the anterior vaginal wall protruding.
savollar.savol: Which organ is most likely prolapsing?
savollar.izoh: Oldingi qin devori prolapsi - sistotsele (siydik pufagi), eng ko'p uchraydigan turi. Orqa devor - rektotsele/enterotsele.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 5 marta qin orqali tuqqan 67 yoshli ayolda chanoqda bosim hissi va kuchanganda kuchayadigan qin kirishidagi bo'rtma, shuningdek tez-tez siyish bor. Ko'rikda qinning oldingi devori bo'rtib chiqqan.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi a'zo eng ehtimoliy tushgan?

savollar.vinyetka: A 26-year-old woman at 30 weeks of gestation has sharp, brief pain in both groins when she stands up quickly or coughs. Exam and ultrasound are normal. The pain is attributed to stretching of a ligament that traverses the inguinal canal.
savollar.savol: From which embryologic structure is this ligament derived?
savollar.izoh: Bachadonning yumaloq boylami chov kanali orqali katta labga boradi; u (tuxumdon boylami kabi) gubernakulum qoldig'i.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Homiladorligi 30 haftalik 26 yoshli ayolda tez turganda yoki yo'talganda ikkala chovda o'tkir, qisqa og'riq bo'ladi. Ko'rik va UTT normal. Og'riq chov kanalidan o'tuvchi boylam cho'zilishi bilan bog'landi.
savollar.savol_uz: Bu boylam qaysi embrional tuzilmadan hosil bo'ladi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 28-year-old woman has a cesarean delivery for breech presentation. The obstetrician makes a low transverse incision in the thin lower segment of the uterus.
savollar.savol: From which part of the uterus does this segment develop?
savollar.izoh: Pastki segment istmusdan hosil bo'ladi; bu yerdagi ko'ndalang kesma kam qon yo'qotish va keyingi homiladorlikda yorilish xavfi pastligi bilan afzal.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 28 yoshli ayolga homilaning dumba bilan kelishi sababli kesar kesish qilindi. Akusher bachadonning yupqa pastki segmentida past ko'ndalang kesma qildi.
savollar.savol_uz: Bu segment bachadonning qaysi qismidan rivojlanadi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 39-year-old woman has a left ovarian mass. Surgical staging shows metastatic tumor in lymph nodes. Inguinal nodes are normal.
savollar.savol: Which nodes are most likely involved first?
savollar.izoh: Tuxumdon limfasi tuxumdon tomirlari bo'ylab paraaortal (lateral aortal) tugunlarga quyiladi - chov tugunlariga emas.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 39 yoshli ayolda chap tuxumdon massasi bor. Jarrohlik bosqichlashda limfa tugunlarida metastaz topildi. Chov tugunlari normal.
savollar.savol_uz: Birinchi navbatda qaysi tugunlar zararlanadi?

kartalar.savol: Tuxumdon arteriyasi qayerdan chiqadi va qaysi boylam ichida o'tadi?
kartalar.javob: Aorta abdominalis; lig. suspensorium ovarii (infundibulopelvik)

kartalar.savol: Chap tuxumdon venasi qayerga quyiladi?
kartalar.javob: V. renalis sinistra - chap buyrak venasi

kartalar.savol: Tuxumdon limfasi qaysi tugunlarga boradi?
kartalar.javob: Nodi para-aortici (lateral aortal) - chovga emas

kartalar.savol: Estrogenlarning kuchi bo'yicha tartibi qanday?
kartalar.javob: Estradiol > estron > estriol

kartalar.savol: Homila holatining ko'rsatkichi bo'lgan estrogen qaysi?
kartalar.javob: Estriol - homiladorlikda ~1000 marta oshadi

kartalar.savol: Urug'lanish bachadon nayining qaysi qismida bo'ladi?
kartalar.javob: Ampulla tubae uterinae - ampula

kartalar.savol: Kesar kesish uchun bachadonning qaysi qismi afzal?
kartalar.javob: Isthmus uteri - pastki segment, ko'ndalang kesma

kartalar.savol: Bo'yin saratoni va Pap-test qaysi sohada?
kartalar.javob: Zona transformationis - skvamokolumnar chegara

kartalar.savol: Gisterektomiyada qaysi boylamdagi arteriya bog'langanda ureter jarohatlanadi?
kartalar.javob: Lig. cardinale - a. uterina (ko'prik ostidagi suv)

kartalar.savol: Yumaloq boylam qayerdan qayerga boradi va nimadan hosil bo'ladi?
kartalar.javob: Bachadon shoxi -> katta lablar (chov kanali orqali); gubernakulum

kartalar.savol: Eng ko'p uchraydigan chanoq prolapsi qaysi?
kartalar.javob: Cystocele - siydik pufagi (oldingi kompartment)

rasm_testlar.izoh: Bachadon arteriyasi (a. iliaca interna tarmog'i) bo'yin yonida ureter USTIDAN o'tadi - gisterektomiyada ureter xavf ostida.

rasm_testlar.izoh: Duglas bo'shlig'i - tik turganda qorin bo'shlig'ining eng past nuqtasi; qon, yiring shu yerga yig'iladi, orqa gumbaz orqali punksiya qilinadi.

xulosa: Tuxumdon infundibulopelvik boylam orqali chanoq devoriga osilgan; unda tuxumdon arteriyasi (aortadan) va venasi o'tadi.
O'ng tuxumdon venasi VCI ga, chap venasi chap buyrak venasiga quyiladi; limfasi - paraaortal tugunlarga.
Estrogen kuchi: estradiol (tuxumdon) > estron (yog') > estriol (platsenta); estriol homila holatini ko'rsatadi.
Progesteron: sekretor endometriy, quyuq bo'yin shilimshig'i, harorat oshishi; tug'ruqdan keyin tushishi laktatsiyani boshlaydi.
Nay: voronka (fimbriyalar), ampula (urug'lanish), bo'yincha, devor ichidagi qism; mezosalpinks ushlab turadi.
Bachadon normalda antefleks va antevers; istmus pastki segmentga aylanadi - kesar kesish shu yerda.
Bachadon arteriyasi ichki yonbosh arteriyasidan chiqib, kardinal boylamda ureter USTIDAN o'tadi.
Endometriy saratoni - progesteronsiz estrogen; mioma - estrogenga sezgir benign o'sma, popkorn kalsifikatsiya.
Bo'yin saratoni transformatsiya zonasida HPV 16/18 dan; yon devorga tarqalib gidronefroz beradi.
Adneksa buralishi - avval vena/limfa, keyin arteriya to'siladi; prolapsning eng ko'p turi - sistotsele.

Ejaculatory duct opens into the prostatic urethra

Urethra: prostatic -> membranous -> spongy (penile)

Produce MIF (anti-Mullerian hormone)

bandlar: Tight junctions between Sertoli cells form the blood-testis barrier
Barrier isolates gametes from autoimmune attack
Sertoli cells are temperature-sensitive
Heat (varicocele, cryptorchidism) lowers sperm count and inhibin B
postlar.izoh:
🚧 Qon-moyak to'sig'i:
• qo'shni Sertoli hujayralari orasidagi ZICH TUTASHMALAR (tight junctions) urug' kanalchasini ikki bo'limga ajratadi:
  - BAZAL bo'lim - spermatogoniyalar (qon bilan aloqada);
  - ADLYUMINAL bo'lim - spermatotsitlar va spermatidalar;
• meyozdan keyingi hujayralar balog'atda paydo bo'ladi, immun tizim ularni "o'ziniki" deb tanimaydi - to'siq ularni AUTOIMMUN hujumdan himoya qiladi.

⚠️ To'siq buzilsa (travma, vazektomiya, orxit) -> spermatozoidlarga qarshi antitelolar -> bepushtlik.

🌡 HARORAT:
• Sertoli hujayralari haroratga SEZGIR: harorat oshsa spermatozoid hosil bo'lishi va ingibin B kamayadi (FSH oshadi);
• Leydig hujayralari esa haroratga sezgir emas - testosteron normal qoladi.

🔥 Harorat oshiradigan holatlar: VARIKOTSELE, KRIPTORXIZM (tushmagan moyak), issiq vanna, tor kiyim.

💡 USMLE: kriptorxizmda - spermatozoid va ingibin kam, FSH yuqori; testosteron va LH odatda normal.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Located in the interstitium between seminiferous tubules
Secrete testosterone in response to LH
Testosterone production is not affected by temperature
Female homolog: theca interna cells
postlar.izoh:
🟠 Leydig (interstitsial) hujayralari:

📍 Joyi: urug' kanalchalari ORASIDAGI biriktiruvchi to'qima - INTERSTITSIY (qon kapillyarlari yonida).

⚙️ Vazifasi: ENDOKRIN hujayralar - LH (lyuteinlovchi gormon) ta'sirida xolesterindan TESTOSTERON ishlab chiqaradi.

🌡 Haroratga SEZGIR EMAS - varikotsele yoki kriptorxizmda testosteron ishlab chiqarilishi saqlanadi (Sertolidan farqli).

🔬 Gistologiyasi: eozinofil sitoplazma, lipid tomchilari, ba'zan Reinke kristallari.

♀️ Ayollardagi gomologi - TEKA INTERNA hujayralari (ular ham LH ta'sirida androgen hosil qiladi).

🧠 Eslab qolish:
• LH -> Leydig (L va L);
• FSH -> Sertoli ("Sertoli FSH ni Sevadi").

💡 USMLE: ekzogen testosteron (anabolik steroidlar) LH va FSH ni bosadi -> moyaklar kichrayadi va bepushtlik (kanalcha ichidagi testosteron kamayadi). Leydig hujayrali o'sma - erta balog'at yoki ginekomastiya beradi.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Spermatogonia line the tubule on the basement membrane
They maintain the germ cell pool (stem cells)
They produce primary spermatocytes -> meiosis
Spermatids mature into spermatozoa toward the lumen
postlar.izoh:
🌀 Urug' kanalchasi - spermatogenez joyi (~64 kun).

🔄 Hujayralar bazal membranadan BO'SHLIQQA qarab joylashadi:

1️⃣ SPERMATOGONIYALAR (germ hujayralar):
• kanalchani bazal membrana ustida qoplab turadi;
• o'zak hujayralar - mitoz bilan bo'linib, jinsiy hujayralar zaxirasini saqlaydi;
• 1-tartib SPERMATOTSITLARNI hosil qiladi.

2️⃣ 1-tartib spermatotsitlar (4N) -> 1-meyoz -> 2-tartib spermatotsitlar (2N) -> 2-meyoz -> SPERMATIDALAR (1N).

3️⃣ Spermatidalar -> spermiogenez (akrosoma, dum hosil bo'ladi) -> SPERMATOZOIDLAR -> bo'shliqqa chiqadi, so'ng moyak ortig'ida harakatchanlik oladi.

🧱 Ular orasida - Sertoli hujayralari ("ustunlar").

💡 USMLE: kanalcha devorida germ hujayralar umuman bo'lmasa, faqat Sertoli hujayralari qolsa - "Sertoli-cell-only" sindromi (azoospermiya, FSH yuqori). Klaynfelter sindromida (47,XXY) kanalchalar gialinlashadi.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Right testis/ovary -> right gonadal vein -> IVC
Left testis/ovary -> left gonadal vein -> left renal vein -> IVC
Left vein enters the renal vein at 90 degrees - less laminar flow
Higher left venous pressure -> varicocele more common on the left

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Ovaries/testes/uterine fundus -> para-aortic nodes
Uterine body/cervix/upper bladder -> external iliac nodes
Prostate/cervix/corpus cavernosum/proximal vagina -> internal iliac
Distal vagina/vulva/scrotum/distal anus -> superficial inguinal; glans -> deep
postlar.izoh:
🟢 Chanoq a'zolari limfasi - qaysi tugunga?

1️⃣ PARAAORTAL tugunlar:
• tuxumdonlar, MOYAKLAR, bachadon tubi.

2️⃣ TASHQI yonbosh tugunlari:
• bachadon tanasi, bo'yni, siydik pufagining yuqori qismi.

3️⃣ ICHKI yonbosh tugunlari:
• PROSTATA, bachadon bo'yni, g'ovak tana (corpus cavernosum), qinning yuqori qismi, siydik pufagining pastki qismi.

4️⃣ YUZA CHOV tugunlari:
• qinning pastki qismi, vulva, YORG'OQ (scrotum), anusning pastki qismi (tishsimon chiziqdan pastda).

5️⃣ CHUQUR CHOV tugunlari:
• klitor, olatning boshchasi (glans penis).

⚠️ Klinik: MOYAK saratoni -> paraaortal tugunlar (chovga EMAS!), chunki moyak qorin orqa devorida rivojlanib pastga tushgan. YORG'OQ terisi saratoni -> yuza chov tugunlari.

💡 Shuning uchun moyak o'smasida biopsiya yorg'oq orqali qilinmaydi (orxiektomiya chov orqali) - limfa yo'llari aralashib ketmasin.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Dilated veins of the pampiniform plexus
Caused by increased venous pressure
Most common cause of scrotal enlargement in adult men
Usually left-sided (left gonadal vein -> left renal vein)

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: 'Bag of worms' on palpation, worse standing or with Valsalva
Ultrasound confirms; does not transilluminate
Right-sided varicocele: think IVC obstruction (e.g., RCC)
Treatment: ligation or embolization if pain or infertility

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Erection = parasympathetic (pelvic splanchnic nerves, S2-S4)
NO -> raised cGMP -> smooth muscle relaxation -> vasodilation
Norepinephrine -> raised Ca2+ -> vasoconstriction (anti-erectile)
PDE-5 inhibitors (sildenafil) block cGMP breakdown
postlar.izoh:
🔹 Erkak jinsiy reaksiyasi uch bosqich: "POINT, SQUEEZE, AND SHOOT".

1️⃣ EREKSIYA (point) - PARASIMPATIK:
• chanoq splanxnik nervlari (nn. splanchnici pelvici, S2-S4);
• endoteliy va nervlardan AZOT OKSIDI (NO) ajraladi -> guanilatsiklaza -> cGMP oshadi -> g'ovak tanalar va arteriyalar silliq mushagi BO'SHASHADI -> qon kirib to'ladi -> venalar bosiladi (venookklyuziya).

⛔ Anti-erektil ta'sir: NORADRENALIN (simpatik) -> hujayra ichida Ca2+ oshadi -> silliq mushak qisqaradi -> vazokonstriksiya -> ereksiya yo'qoladi (detumessensiya).

💊 PDE-5 ingibitorlari (sildenafil, tadalafil) - cGMP parchalanishini to'xtatadi -> ereksiya kuchayadi.
⚠️ NITRATLAR bilan birga BERILMAYDI - ikkalasi ham cGMP ni oshiradi -> og'ir gipotenziya.

🧠 "S2, 3, 4 keep the penis off the floor" - S2-S4 ereksiyani ta'minlaydi.

💡 USMLE: prostatektomiyadan keyingi impotensiya - prostata yonidagi kavernoz (parasimpatik) nervlar shikastlanishi.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Emission = sympathetic (hypogastric nerve, T11-L2)
Moves semen into the prostatic urethra; internal sphincter closes
Expulsion (ejaculation) = pudendal nerve (visceral and somatic)
Bulbospongiosus and ischiocavernosus contract rhythmically

bandlar: Rotation of the testis around the spermatic cord and vessels
Most common in boys 12-18 years old
Bell clapper: poor fixation to tunica vaginalis, horizontal testis
May follow trauma or occur spontaneously
postlar.izoh:
🌀 Moyak buralishi (torsion) - moyakning urug' tizimchasi va qon tomir oyoqchasi atrofida aylanishi.

👦 Yoshi: ko'pincha 12-18 yoshli o'smirlar (yangi tug'ilganlarda ham bo'lishi mumkin).

🔔 Sababi - "QO'NG'IROQ TILI" (bell clapper) nuqsoni:
• normalda moyak orqa tomondan yorg'oq devoriga (gubernakulum qoldig'i orqali) mahkamlangan, qin parda uni faqat oldindan o'raydi;
• nuqsonda qin parda moyakni BUTUNLAY o'rab oladi -> moyak orqadan mahkamlanmaydi;
• moyak GORIZONTAL holatda erkin osilib turadi - qo'ng'iroq ichidagi til kabi -> oson aylanadi.

⚡ Qo'zg'atuvchi: jarohat, jismoniy zo'riqish yoki o'z-o'zidan (ko'pincha uyquda - kremaster mushagining qisqarishi).

🩸 Oqibati: avval vena bosiladi -> shish -> keyin arteriya to'siladi -> moyak ISHEMIYASI va nekrozi.

⚠️ Nuqson ko'pincha IKKI TOMONLAMA - shuning uchun boshqa moyak ham xavf ostida.

bandlar: Acute severe scrotal pain, high-riding testis
Absent cremasteric reflex; negative Prehn sign
Orchiopexy within 6 hours; manual detorsion if surgery delayed
Bilateral orchiopexy; orchiectomy if testis not viable

bandlar: Serous fluid collection within the tunica vaginalis
Congenital (communicating): patent processus vaginalis - infants
Acquired (noncommunicating): infection, trauma, tumor
Transilluminates; bloody fluid = hematocele

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Cyst from a dilated epididymal duct or rete testis
Paratesticular fluctuant nodule, separate from the testis
Usually at the head of the epididymis, above the testis
Transilluminates; contains sperm; usually painless

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Paired glands on the posterior-inferior surface of the bladder
Folded mucosa with pseudostratified columnar epithelium
Produce ~70% of ejaculate: fructose, citrate, prostaglandins
Fructose = main energy source for sperm motility

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Formed by the seminal vesicle duct + ductus deferens (ampulla)
Passes through the prostate
Opens into the prostatic urethra on the seminal colliculus
Prostatic utricle lies between the two openings

bandlar: 30-50 branched tubuloalveolar glands draining into the urethra
Fibroelastic capsule rich in smooth muscle
Periurethral submucosal glands + main peripheral glands
Secretes acid phosphatase, citric acid, fibrinolysin, PSA

bandlar: Transition (periurethral) zone -> benign prostatic hyperplasia
Peripheral (posterior) zone -> prostatic carcinoma
Peripheral zone is felt on digital rectal exam
BPH compresses the urethra early; cancer obstructs late

bandlar: Men >50; hyperplasia (not hypertrophy) of the transition zone
Smooth, elastic, firm nodular enlargement; not premalignant
Frequency, nocturia, hesitancy, weak stream, dysuria
Total PSA up with a high free fraction; may cause hydronephrosis, UTI

bandlar: Alpha-1 antagonists (terazosin, tamsulosin): relax smooth muscle
5-alpha-reductase inhibitors (finasteride): shrink the prostate
PDE-5 inhibitors (tadalafil)
Surgery: TURP or ablation

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Most often in the peripheral (posterior) zone - palpable on DRE
Yellow, firm, gritty tumor; PIN is a precursor lesion
Asymptomatic until late: hard nodule, obstruction, back pain
Raised PSA; frequent osteoblastic bone metastases (lumbar spine, pelvis)
postlar.izoh:
🎗 Prostata saratoni (adenokarsinoma):

📍 Joyi: ko'pincha PERIFERIK zonada (orqa bo'lak) - to'g'ri ichak orqali barmoq bilan tekshiruvda (DRE) paypaslanadi.

🔬 Makroskopik: SARIQ, QATTIQ, "qumloq" (gritty) o'sma, atrof tuzilmalarga o'sib kiradi. Prostata intraepitelial neoplaziyasi (PIN) - saratonoldi o'zgarish, ko'pincha birga uchraydi.

🩺 Klinikasi:
• uzoq vaqt BELGISIZ (kanaldan uzoq);
• kech bosqichda: DRE da QATTIQ, notekis tugun; obstruktiv uropatiya; bel yoki chanoq og'rig'i.

🧪 Tashxis: qon zardobida PSA oshishi (erkin PSA ulushi past), so'ng biopsiya (Glison darajasi).

🦴 Metastaz: SUYAKLARGA (bel umurtqalari, chanoq) tez-tez - OSTEOBLASTIK (suyak hosil qiluvchi) o'choqlar; ishqoriy fosfataza oshadi. Yo'li - prostata venoz chigali -> umurtqa venoz chigali (Batson, klapansiz).

💡 Rasmda (Spalteholz) erkak chanog'ining median kesimi: prostata, rectum, pars prostatica et membranacea urethrae - DRE da prostataning orqa yuzasi to'g'ri ichak oldingi devori orqali paypaslanadi.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Leuprolide: GnRH agonist given continuously suppresses LH/FSH
Result: testosterone falls (androgen deprivation)
Flutamide, cyproterone: androgen receptor antagonists
Also radiation and/or prostatectomy
