bandlar: Dome rupture: blunt trauma to a full bladder (seatbelt)
Dome is the weakest part -> intraperitoneal urine leak
Peritoneal urine absorption -> raised BUN and creatinine
Pelvic fracture -> anterior wall/neck tear -> extraperitoneal (retropubic) leak

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Perineal straddle injury -> bulbar (spongy) urethra disrupted
Blood at the meatus, hematuria, difficulty voiding; scrotal hematoma
If Buck fascia is torn, urine leaks into the superficial perineal space
Urethral catheterization is relatively contraindicated
postlar.izoh:
🚲 Siydik chiqarish kanalining OLDINGI qismi jarohati:

👨 Deyarli faqat ERKAKLARDA.

⚡ Mexanizmi: oraliqqa minib tushish (STRADDLE) - velosiped ramasi, panjara ustiga yiqilish -> kanalning BULBAR (g'ovak) qismi qov suyagi va zarba beruvchi jism orasida eziladi.

🩺 Belgilari:
• siydik chiqarish teshigida (meatus) QON;
• gematuriya, siyish qiyinligi;
• YORG'OQ GEMATOMASI.

🗺 Siydik/qon tarqalishi fassiyalarga bog'liq:
• Bak fassiyasi (Buck) butun bo'lsa - qon olat bo'ylab cheklanadi;
• Bak fassiyasi YIRTILSA - siydik YUZA ORALIQ bo'shlig'iga chiqadi va Kolles fassiyasi ostida yorg'oq, olat va qorin old devoriga tarqaladi (son tomon emas - Kolles fassiyasi son fassiyasiga yopishgan); "kapalak" shaklidagi oraliq gematomasi.

⚠️ Siydik chiqarish teshigida qon bo'lsa - URETRAL KATETER qo'yish NISBIY QARSHI KO'RSATMA (yarim yirtilish to'liqqa aylanishi mumkin) -> avval retrograd uretrografiya, kerak bo'lsa qov usti sistostomiya.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Pelvic fracture -> disruption at the bulbomembranous junction
Bulbomembranous junction is the weakest point
Urine leaks into the retropubic space
High-riding prostate on rectal exam; blood at meatus

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Diamond-shaped region below the pelvic diaphragm
Urogenital triangle (anterior) and anal triangle (posterior)
Superficial muscles: ischiocavernosus, bulbospongiosus, superficial transverse perineal
Innervated mainly by the pudendal nerve (S2-S4)
postlar.izoh:
💎 Oraliq (perineum) - chanoq diafragmasidan PASTDAGI romb shaklidagi soha.

📐 Chegaralari: oldinda qov birikmasi, yonlarda quymuch-qov tarmoqlari va quymuch do'mboqlari, orqada dum suyagi.

🔺 Ikki quymuch do'mbog'ini tutashtiruvchi chiziq uni ikkiga bo'ladi:
• OLDINGI - SIYDIK-TANOSIL uchburchagi: siydik chiqarish kanali (ayolda qin ham), tashqi jinsiy a'zolar;
• ORQA - ANAL uchburchak: anus, tashqi anal sfinkter, quymuch-to'g'ri ichak chuqurchalari.

💪 Yuza oraliq mushaklari (siydik-tanosil uchburchagida):
• m. ischiocavernosus - olat/klitor oyoqchalarini qoplaydi;
• m. bulbospongiosus - piyozcha (bulbus) ni qoplaydi; eyakulyatsiya va siydik qoldig'ini chiqarishda qatnashadi;
• m. transversus perinei superficialis.

⚡ Asosiy nervi: JINSIY NERV (n. pudendus, S2-S4), qon tomiri: ichki jinsiy arteriya (a. pudenda interna).

💡 Rasmda (Spalteholz) erkak oralig'i mushaklari pastdan: m. ischiocavernosus, m. bulbocavernosus, m. transversus perinei superficialis, m. sphincter ani externus, m. levator ani.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Muscular floor of the pelvis; separates pelvic cavity from perineum
Formed by levator ani + coccygeus with their fasciae
Strong support for pelvic organs
Transmits the urethra, vagina and anorectum to the perineum

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Part of levator ani forming a U-shaped sling around the anorectal junction
Pulls the junction forward - creates the anorectal angle
Marks the boundary between rectum and anal canal
Essential for fecal continence; relaxes during defecation

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: Urogenital diaphragm and external urethral sphincter
bandlar: Lies in the perineum below the pelvic diaphragm
Sphincter urethrae + deep transverse perineal between the ischiopubic rami
Pierced by the urethra (and vagina in females)
Sphincter urethrae = voluntary external sphincter around membranous urethra
postlar.izoh:
🟥 Urogenital diafragma (siydik-tanosil diafragmasi, chuqur oraliq bo'shlig'i):

📍 Joyi: ORALIQDA, chanoq diafragmasidan PASTDA; ikkala QUYMUCH-QOV TARMOQLARI orasida gorizontal tortilgan.

🧩 Tarkibi - 2 ta ko'ndalang-targ'il mushak:
1. SIYDIK CHIQARISH KANALI SFINKTERI (m. sphincter urethrae);
2. ORALIQNING CHUQUR KO'NDALANG MUSHAGI (m. transversus perinei profundus).
• pastdan oraliq membranasi (fascia trigoni urogenitalis inferior) bilan qoplangan.

🕳 Teshib o'tuvchilar: erkakda - siydik chiqarish kanali; ayolda - siydik chiqarish kanali va QIN.

🔒 Siydik chiqarish kanali sfinkteri:
• kanalning PARDA (membranoz) qismini o'rab turadi;
• TASHQI uretral sfinkter - IXTIYORIY (ko'ndalang-targ'il) siyish mushagi;
• SIYDIK TUTISHNI ta'minlaydi; nervi - n. pudendus (S2-S4).

📦 Erkakda bu yerda bulbouretral (Kuper) bezlari ham joylashgan.

💡 Ikkala diafragma (chanoq va urogenital) ham jinsiy nerv tarmoqlaridan innervatsiya oladi. Rasmda (Spalteholz) erkak urogenital uchburchagi pastdan: m. sphincter urethrae membranaceae, m. transversus perinei profundus, urethra (pars membranacea), glandula bulbourethralis.

postlar.sarlavha: Perineal body and female perineal muscles
bandlar: Perineal body: fibromuscular node between vagina/bulb and anus
Attachments: bulbospongiosus, transverse perineals, external anal sphincter
Also levator ani fibers - key support of the pelvic floor
Structures cut in episiotomy lie here

bandlar: Incision to enlarge the vaginal opening during childbirth
Median: skin -> vaginal wall -> perineal body -> superficial transverse perineal
Median risks cutting the external anal sphincter
Mediolateral (45 degrees): cuts bulbospongiosus; more bleeding, more room

bandlar: Pelvic diaphragm and urogenital diaphragm
Perineal membrane and perineal body
Transverse cervical (cardinal) and uterosacral ligaments
Weakness -> uterine prolapse, cystocele or rectocele

bandlar: Pudendal nerve (S2-S4) crosses posterior to the ischial spine
Exits greater sciatic foramen, re-enters via lesser sciatic foramen
Ischial spine is the landmark for the block (transvaginal)
Anesthetizes the perineum for delivery or episiotomy repair

savollar.vinyetka: A 15-year-old boy wakes at night with sudden severe left scrotal pain and vomiting. The left testis is high-riding with a horizontal lie. Stroking the inner thigh does not elevate the testis, and lifting the testis does not relieve the pain.
savollar.savol: What is the most appropriate next step?
savollar.izoh: Moyak buralishi: kremaster refleksi yo'q, Prehn manfiy. 6 soat ichida ikki tomonlama orxiopeksiya; UTT kutib vaqt yo'qotilmaydi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 15 yoshli o'smir tunda chap yorg'oqdagi to'satdan kuchli og'riq va qusish bilan uyg'ondi. Chap moyak yuqori ko'tarilgan va gorizontal joylashgan. Sonning ichki yuzasi silanganda moyak ko'tarilmaydi, moyakni ko'tarish og'riqni kamaytirmaydi.
savollar.savol_uz: Keyingi eng to'g'ri qadam qaysi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 27-year-old man is evaluated for infertility. On standing there is a soft left scrotal mass that feels like a 'bag of worms', enlarges with Valsalva and decreases when supine. It does not transilluminate.
savollar.savol: Why is this condition more common on the left?
javoblar: Left gonadal vein joins renal vein at 90 degrees
Left testicular a. arises from renal a.
Left testis lies higher than the right
Left pampiniform plexus has no valves normally
Left gonadal vein drains directly into the IVC
savollar.izoh: Chap moyak venasi chap buyrak venasiga 90° burchakda quyiladi - oqim kam laminar, bosim yuqori -> chap varikotsele.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 27 yoshli erkak bepushtlik bo'yicha tekshirilmoqda. Tik turganda chap yorg'oqda "qurt to'la xalta" kabi yumshoq massa bor, u Valsalvada kattalashadi va yotganda kichrayadi. Transillyuminatsiya bermaydi.
savollar.savol_uz: Nega bu holat chap tomonda ko'proq uchraydi?
javoblar_uz: chap vena buyrak venasiga 90° da quyiladi
chap gonadal vena VCI ga to'g'ridan quyiladi

savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old man has a new right-sided varicocele that does not decompress when he lies down. He also reports hematuria and weight loss. A right flank mass is palpable.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely cause of the varicocele?
javoblar: Renal cell carcinoma invading the renal vein and IVC
Nutcracker compression of the left renal vein
savollar.izoh: O'ng moyak venasi to'g'ridan VCI ga quyiladi; o'ng varikotsele (yotganda kamaymaydigan) - VCI obstruksiyasi, masalan RCC ning vena ichiga o'sishi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 58 yoshli erkakda yotganda kamaymaydigan yangi o'ng varikotsele paydo bo'ldi. Shuningdek gematuriya va vazn yo'qotish bor. O'ng yon sohada massa paypaslanadi.
savollar.savol_uz: Varikotselening eng ehtimoliy sababi nima?
javoblar_uz: buyrak venasi va VCI ga o'sgan RCC

savollar.vinyetka: A 6-month-old boy has a painless right scrotal swelling that is larger in the evening and smaller in the morning. The swelling transilluminates brightly, and the testis is normal.
savollar.savol: What is the underlying cause?
javoblar: Incomplete obliteration of the processus vaginalis
Germ cell tumor of the testis
savollar.izoh: Tug'ma (kommunikatsiyalanuvchi) gidrotsele - qin o'simtasi bekilmagan; chaqaloqlarda ko'p, ko'pi 1 yoshgacha o'tib ketadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 6 oylik o'g'il bolada o'ng yorg'oqda og'riqsiz shish bor, u kechqurun kattaroq, ertalab kichikroq bo'ladi. Shish yorug'likni yaxshi o'tkazadi, moyak normal.
savollar.savol_uz: Asosiy sabab nima?

savollar.vinyetka: A 40-year-old man notes a painless lump in the scrotum. Exam shows a 1.5-cm fluctuant nodule above and separate from a normal testis, at the head of the epididymis. It transilluminates; aspiration yields milky fluid with sperm.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely diagnosis?
savollar.izoh: Spermatotsele - moyak ortig'i yo'li yoki rete testis kistasi: moyakdan alohida, ortiq boshida, transillyuminatsiya beradi, ichida sperma.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 40 yoshli erkak yorg'oqda og'riqsiz tugun sezdi. Ko'rikda normal moyakdan yuqorida va undan alohida, moyak ortig'i boshida 1,5 sm fluktuatsiyali tugun. U yorug'lik o'tkazadi; aspiratsiyada spermali sutsimon suyuqlik.
savollar.savol_uz: Eng ehtimoliy tashxis qaysi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 29-year-old man has had a left inguinal undescended testis since childhood. Semen analysis shows oligospermia. Serum FSH is elevated and inhibin B is low, while LH and testosterone are normal.
savollar.savol: Which cell type is mainly impaired?
savollar.izoh: Sertoli hujayralari haroratga sezgir: kriptorxizmda spermatogenez va ingibin B kamayadi, FSH oshadi; Leydig (testosteron) normal.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 29 yoshli erkakda bolalikdan chap chovda tushmagan moyak bor. Spermogrammada oligospermiya. Qonda FSH yuqori, ingibin B past, LH va testosteron esa normal.
savollar.savol_uz: Asosan qaysi hujayra turi zararlangan?

savollar.vinyetka: A 25-year-old bodybuilder injects anabolic steroids for 2 years. He now has small, soft testes and a very low sperm count.
savollar.savol: Which change best explains his low sperm count?
savollar.izoh: Ekzogen testosteron LH va FSH ni bosadi -> Leydig hujayralari kam ishlaydi, kanalcha ichidagi testosteron tushadi -> spermatogenez to'xtaydi, moyak kichrayadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 25 yoshli bodibilder 2 yil davomida anabolik steroidlar ukol qilgan. Hozir moyaklari kichik va yumshoq, spermatozoidlar soni juda past.
savollar.savol_uz: Spermatozoidlar kamligini qaysi o'zgarish yaxshiroq tushuntiradi?
javoblar_uz: LH bosilib moyak ichi testosteroni kamayadi
yuqori ingibin B FSH ni oshiradi

savollar.vinyetka: A 62-year-old man with chest pain takes sublingual nitroglycerin. He asks whether he can also take a drug for erectile dysfunction that works by preventing breakdown of the second messenger mediating erection.
savollar.savol: Why is this combination dangerous?
javoblar: Both raise cGMP and cause severe hypotension
savollar.izoh: PDE-5 ingibitori cGMP parchalanishini to'xtatadi, nitratlar NO orqali cGMP ni oshiradi -> birga og'ir gipotenziya.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Ko'krak og'rig'i bo'lgan 62 yoshli erkak til ostiga nitroglitserin qabul qiladi. U ereksiyani ta'minlovchi ikkilamchi vositachining parchalanishini to'xtatuvchi erektil disfunksiya dorisini ham ichsa bo'ladimi, deb so'raydi.
savollar.savol_uz: Nega bu birikma xavfli?
javoblar_uz: ikkalasi cGMP ni oshirib og'ir gipotenziya beradi

savollar.vinyetka: A 30-year-old man undergoes retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer. Afterward he has normal erections and orgasm but no antegrade ejaculate; urine after orgasm contains sperm.
savollar.savol: Injury to which nerves explains this?
savollar.izoh: Emissiya va ichki sfinkter yopilishi - simpatik (gipogastral, T11-L2). Ular shikastlansa - retrograd eyakulyatsiya; ereksiya (parasimpatik) saqlanadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 30 yoshli erkakka moyak saratoni sababli retroperitoneal limfa tugunlari olib tashlandi. Keyin ereksiya va orgazm normal, lekin sperma tashqariga chiqmaydi; orgazmdan keyingi siydikda spermatozoidlar bor.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi nervlar shikastlanishi buni tushuntiradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 68-year-old man has nocturia, hesitancy and a weak stream. Digital rectal exam reveals a smooth, symmetric, rubbery enlarged prostate. Total PSA is mildly elevated with a high free PSA fraction.
savollar.savol: Which zone of the prostate is primarily involved?
savollar.izoh: BPH tranzitor (periuretral) zonada boshlanadi va kanalni erta bosadi; erkin PSA ulushi yuqori. Saraton - periferik zonada.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 68 yoshli erkakda nokturiya, siyishni boshlash qiyinligi va kuchsiz oqim bor. To'g'ri ichak orqali tekshiruvda silliq, simmetrik, rezinasimon kattalashgan prostata. Umumiy PSA biroz oshgan, erkin PSA ulushi yuqori.
savollar.savol_uz: Prostataning qaysi zonasi asosan zararlangan?

savollar.vinyetka: A 70-year-old man with benign prostatic hyperplasia and hypertension wants a drug that will improve his urinary flow within days by relaxing smooth muscle of the prostate and bladder neck.
savollar.savol: Which drug is most appropriate?
savollar.izoh: Alfa-1 blokator (terazozin) prostata va pufak bo'yni silliq mushagini tez bo'shashtiradi va bosimni ham tushiradi. Finasterid sekin (oylar).
savollar.vinyetka_uz: BPH va gipertenziyasi bor 70 yoshli erkak prostata va pufak bo'yni silliq mushagini bo'shashtirib, bir necha kunda siydik oqimini yaxshilovchi dori istaydi.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi dori eng to'g'ri?

savollar.vinyetka: A 72-year-old man has low back pain. Digital rectal exam shows a hard, irregular nodule in the posterior prostate. PSA is 48 ng/mL and alkaline phosphatase is elevated. Imaging shows sclerotic lesions in the lumbar spine.
savollar.savol: Which is the most appropriate hormonal treatment?
savollar.izoh: Metastatik prostata saratoni - androgen deprivatsiyasi: uzluksiz GnRH agonisti (leyprolid) LH/FSH ni bosadi; boshidagi flare uchun flutamid qo'shiladi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 72 yoshli erkakda bel og'rig'i bor. To'g'ri ichak orqali tekshiruvda prostata orqa qismida qattiq, notekis tugun. PSA 48 ng/mL, ishqoriy fosfataza oshgan. Tasvirda bel umurtqalarida sklerotik o'choqlar.
savollar.savol_uz: Eng to'g'ri gormonal davo qaysi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 24-year-old man is brought after a car crash in which he was wearing a seatbelt with a full bladder. He has suprapubic pain and hematuria. Two days later BUN and creatinine are rising although renal ultrasound is normal.
savollar.savol: Where has the urine most likely collected?
savollar.izoh: To'la pufakka zarba -> eng zaif gumbaz yoriladi -> siydik qorin bo'shlig'iga; qorin parda siydikni so'rib BUN/kreatininni oshiradi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 24 yoshli erkak avtohalokatdan keyin olib kelindi; u xavfsizlik kamarini taqqan va pufagi to'la bo'lgan. Qov usti og'rig'i va gematuriya bor. Ikki kundan so'ng buyrak UTT normal bo'lsa ham BUN va kreatinin oshmoqda.
savollar.savol_uz: Siydik eng ehtimoliy qayerga yig'ilgan?

savollar.vinyetka: A 35-year-old man has a pelvic fracture after a motorcycle accident. He cannot void and there is blood at the urethral meatus. On rectal exam the prostate is high-riding.
savollar.savol: Which management step is relatively contraindicated before imaging?
savollar.izoh: Orqa uretra (bulbomembranoz) uzilishi: meatusda qon, baland prostata. Avval retrograd uretrografiya; uretral kateter nisbiy qarshi ko'rsatma.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 35 yoshli erkakda mototsikl halokatidan keyin chanoq sinishi bor. U siya olmaydi va siydik chiqarish teshigida qon bor. To'g'ri ichak orqali tekshiruvda prostata yuqori ko'tarilgan.
savollar.savol_uz: Tasvirdan oldin qaysi qadam nisbiy qarshi ko'rsatma?

savollar.vinyetka: A 12-year-old boy falls astride a metal fence. He has blood at the meatus and a scrotal hematoma. Over hours, swelling spreads into the penis, scrotum and lower anterior abdominal wall but not into the thighs.
savollar.savol: Which part of the urethra is injured?
savollar.izoh: Straddle jarohati - bulbar (g'ovak) qism; Bak fassiyasi yirtilsa siydik yuza oraliqqa, Kolles fassiyasi ostida qorin devoriga tarqaladi, songa emas.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 12 yoshli bola metall panjaraga minib yiqildi. Siydik chiqarish teshigida qon va yorg'oq gematomasi bor. Bir necha soatda shish olat, yorg'oq va qorin old devorining pastki qismiga tarqaldi, lekin sonlarga o'tmadi.
savollar.savol_uz: Siydik chiqarish kanalining qaysi qismi jarohatlangan?

savollar.vinyetka: During vaginal delivery, a midline episiotomy is performed. The incision extends further than intended, and the patient later develops fecal incontinence.
savollar.savol: Which muscle was most likely cut?
savollar.izoh: Median epiziotomiya oraliq tanasi orqali o'tadi; davom etsa tashqi anal sfinkter kesiladi -> najas tuta olmaslik. Mediolateral - bulbospongiosus.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Qin orqali tug'ruqda median epiziotomiya qilindi. Kesma mo'ljaldagidan uzoqqa davom etdi va keyin bemorda najas tuta olmaslik paydo bo'ldi.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi mushak eng ehtimoliy kesilgan?

savollar.vinyetka: To provide perineal anesthesia for a forceps delivery, an obstetrician palpates a bony landmark through the lateral vaginal wall and injects local anesthetic just posterior to it.
savollar.savol: Which landmark is palpated?
savollar.izoh: Jinsiy nerv (S2-S4) quymuch o'sig'i orqasidan aylanib o'tadi - pudendal blokadada o'siq qin orqali paypaslanib mo'ljal qilinadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Akusherlik qisqichlari bilan tug'ruqda oraliqni og'riqsizlantirish uchun akusher qinning yon devori orqali suyak belgisini paypaslab, darhol uning orqasiga mahalliy anestetik yuboradi.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi suyak belgisi paypaslanadi?

kartalar.savol: Ingibin B, ABP va MIF ni qaysi hujayralar ishlab chiqaradi?
kartalar.javob: Sertoli hujayralari (gomologi - granulyoza)

kartalar.savol: Testosteronni qaysi hujayralar va qaysi gormon ta'sirida ishlab chiqaradi?
kartalar.javob: Leydig hujayralari - LH ta'sirida (gomologi - teka interna)

kartalar.savol: Qon-moyak to'sig'ini nima hosil qiladi?
kartalar.javob: Sertoli hujayralari orasidagi zich tutashmalar (tight junctions)

kartalar.savol: Nega varikotsele ko'pincha chapda?
kartalar.javob: V. testicularis sinistra -> v. renalis sinistra (90° burchak)

kartalar.savol: Moyak saratoni qaysi limfa tugunlariga tarqaladi?
kartalar.javob: Nodi para-aortici - chovga emas

kartalar.savol: Ereksiya, emissiya va eyakulyatsiya nervlari?
kartalar.javob: Parasimpatik S2-S4; simpatik T11-L2; n. pudendus

kartalar.savol: Moyak buralishining ikki asosiy klinik belgisi?
kartalar.javob: Kremaster refleksi yo'q; Prehn belgisi manfiy

kartalar.savol: Eyakulyatning ~70% ini qaysi bez beradi va asosiy energiya manbai nima?
kartalar.javob: Vesiculae seminales - fruktoza

kartalar.savol: BPH va prostata saratoni qaysi zonalarda boshlanadi?
kartalar.javob: BPH - tranzitor zona; saraton - periferik (orqa) zona

kartalar.savol: Siydik pufagining eng zaif qismi qaysi va yorilsa siydik qayerga oqadi?
kartalar.javob: Gumbaz (dome) - qorin bo'shlig'iga (intraperitoneal)

kartalar.savol: Chanoq sinishida siydik chiqarish kanalining qaysi joyi uziladi?
kartalar.javob: Bulbomembranoz tutashma - siydik qov orti bo'shlig'iga

kartalar.savol: Pudendal blokada uchun mo'ljal qaysi?
kartalar.javob: Spina ischiadica - quymuch o'sig'i (nerv uning orqasidan o'tadi)

rasm_testlar.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain
rasm_testlar.savol: Prostata, urug' yo'llari va pufakchalar (oldindan-yuqoridan). '?' bilan belgilangan, eyakulyatning ~70% ini beruvchi bez qaysi?
javoblar: Ampulla ductus deferentis - urug' yo'li ampulasi
rasm_testlar.izoh: Urug' pufakchasi fruktoza, sitrat va prostaglandinlarga boy sekret beradi; yo'li urug' yo'li bilan qo'shilib otiluvchi yo'lni hosil qiladi.

rasm_testlar.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain
rasm_testlar.savol: O'ng moyak va urug' tizimchasi (lateraldan, ochilgan). '?' bilan belgilangan, kengaysa varikotsele beradigan tuzilma qaysi?
rasm_testlar.izoh: Pampiniform chigal moyak arteriyasini sovutadi; venoz bosim oshsa kengayib varikotsele beradi (ko'pincha chapda).

rasm_testlar.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain
rasm_testlar.savol: Erkak urogenital uchburchagi mushaklari (pastdan). '?' bilan belgilangan, siydik chiqarish kanalining parda qismini o'rab turgan ixtiyoriy mushak qaysi?
javoblar: M. sphincter urethrae - siydik chiqarish kanali sfinkteri
M. transversus perinei profundus - chuqur ko'ndalang oraliq mushagi
M. levator ani - anusni ko'taruvchi mushak
rasm_testlar.izoh: Siydik chiqarish kanali sfinkteri urogenital diafragmada - tashqi (ixtiyoriy) uretral sfinkter, n. pudendus innervatsiyasi, siydik tutishni ta'minlaydi.

xulosa: Sertoli: ingibin B, ABP, MIF, aromataza, qon-moyak to'sig'i; haroratga sezgir, FSH bilan ishlaydi (gomologi granulyoza).
Leydig: LH ta'sirida testosteron, haroratga sezgir emas (gomologi teka interna).
Chap gonadal vena chap buyrak venasiga 90° da quyiladi - varikotsele chapda; o'ng varikotsele - VCI obstruksiyasi (RCC).
Moyak/tuxumdon limfasi - paraaortal; prostata - ichki yonbosh; yorg'oq - yuza chov; glans - chuqur chov tugunlari.
Point (parasimpatik S2-S4, NO-cGMP), squeeze (simpatik T11-L2), shoot (n. pudendus); PDE-5 + nitrat = gipotenziya.
Moyak buralishi: bell clapper, kremaster refleksi yo'q, Prehn manfiy - 6 soatda ikki tomonlama orxiopeksiya.
Gidrotsele va spermatotsele transillyuminatsiya beradi; varikotsele va o'sma bermaydi.
Urug' pufakchalari eyakulyatning ~70% i (fruktoza); otiluvchi yo'l prostata qismiga urug' do'mbog'ida ochiladi.
BPH - tranzitor zona (alfa-1 blokator, finasterid); saraton - periferik zona, osteoblastik metastaz, uzluksiz leyprolid.
Pufak gumbazi - intraperitoneal; chanoq sinishi - ekstraperitoneal/orqa uretra; straddle - bulbar uretra; pudendal blok - quymuch o'sig'i.

bandlar: Regions: axilla, arm, cubital fossa, forearm, carpal tunnel, hand
Axilla: axillary artery/vein + cords of the brachial plexus
Cubital fossa (lateral -> medial): biceps tendon, brachial a., median n.
Carpal tunnel: median nerve + 9 flexor tendons

bandlar: Flexion/extension: sagittal plane (forward/backward)
Abduction/adduction: frontal plane (away from / toward trunk)
Medial (internal) and lateral (external) rotation: long axis
Circumduction = combination of all movements (cone)

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

postlar.sarlavha: Elbow and forearm movements: pronation and supination
bandlar: Elbow: flexion and extension only (hinge)
Pronation: radius crosses over ulna, palm faces posteriorly
Supination: radius parallel to ulna, palm faces anteriorly
Occurs at proximal and distal radioulnar joints
postlar.izoh:
💪 Tirsak va bilak harakatlari:

🔸 Tirsak bo'g'imi (yelka-tirsak qismi) - g'altaksimon: faqat BUKISH va YOZISH.

🔸 Bilak harakatlari - yuqori va pastki bilak-tirsak (radioulnar) bo'g'imlarida:
• PRONATSIYA - bilak suyagi (radius) tirsak suyagi (ulna) ustidan kesishib o'tadi, kaft orqaga/pastga qaraydi;
• SUPINATSIYA - ikki suyak parallel turadi, kaft oldinga/yuqoriga qaraydi (anatomik holat).

⚙️ Harakatlantiruvchi mushaklar (darsdan):
• pronatsiya - m. pronator teres va m. pronator quadratus (n. medianus);
• supinatsiya - m. supinator (n. radialis) va m. biceps brachii (n. musculocutaneus) - bukilgan tirsakda eng kuchli supinator.

🖼 Rasmda (Sobotta): radius - caput (capitulum), collum, tuberositas, processus styloideus; pastda - yuqori bilak-tirsak bo'g'imi (circumferentia articularis, incisura radialis).

rasm.manba: Rasm: Sobotta, Atlas der deskriptiven Anatomie I (1919), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: Wrist, finger and thumb movements; hand joints
bandlar: Finger joints: CMC -> MCP -> PIP -> DIP
Finger abduction/adduction at MCP, axis = middle finger
Thumb is rotated 90°: flexion in plane of palm
Opposition occurs at the saddle CMC joint of the thumb

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Surgical neck: axillary nerve + posterior circumflex humeral a.
Radial groove (midshaft): radial nerve + profunda brachii a.
Supracondylar region: median nerve + brachial artery
Medial epicondyle (posterior groove): ulnar nerve

rasm.manba: Rasm: Sobotta, Atlas der deskriptiven Anatomie I (1919), public domain

bandlar: 8 carpal bones in two rows of four
Proximal row (lat -> med): scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum, pisiform
Distal row (lat -> med): trapezium, trapezoid, capitate, hamate
Wrist joint: radius + scaphoid and lunate (ulna does not articulate)

rasm.manba: Rasm: Sobotta, Atlas der deskriptiven Anatomie I (1919), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: Carpal landmarks and the carpal arch
bandlar: Carpal bones form an arch concave anteriorly (carpal groove)
Medial pillars: pisiform and hook of hamate
Lateral pillars: tubercles of scaphoid and trapezium
Flexor retinaculum bridges the arch -> carpal tunnel
postlar.izoh:
🌉 Kaft usti ravog'i va paypaslanadigan nuqtalar:

Kaft usti suyaklari oldinga botiq RAVOQ hosil qiladi. Uning ustidan ko'ndalang boylam - bukuvchilar retinakulumi (lig. carpi transversum) tortilib, ravoqni KANALGA aylantiradi.

📍 Retinakulum yopishadigan 4 ta "ustun":
• medialda - NO'XATSIMON suyak va ILMOQLI suyak ilmog'i (hamulus ossis hamati);
• lateralda - QAYIQSIMON suyak do'mbog'i va TRAPETSIYA do'mbog'i.

🩺 Klinik ahamiyat:
• ilmoqli suyak ilmog'i sinishi (golf, beysbol, qo'lga yiqilish) - yonidan o'tuvchi n. ulnaris (Guyon kanali) shikastlanadi;
• trapetsiya do'mbog'i - bosh barmoq tepaligi mushaklarining boshlanish joyi.

🖼 Rasmda (Sobotta, kaft tomoni): os pisiforme, tuberculum ossis navicularis, tuberculum ossis multanguli majoris, processus styloideus radii et ulnae.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Sobotta, Atlas der deskriptiven Anatomie I (1919), public domain

bandlar: Roof: flexor retinaculum; floor: carpal bones
Contents: median nerve + 4 FDS + 4 FDP + FPL tendons
Outside: ulnar n./a. (Guyon canal), palmaris longus
FCR runs in its own compartment of the retinaculum

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Right: from brachiocephalic trunk; left: from aortic arch
Branches: vertebral, internal thoracic, thyrocervical trunk
Thyrocervical trunk -> suprascapular, transverse cervical a.
Becomes axillary artery at the lateral border of the 1st rib

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: From lateral border of 1st rib to lower border of teres major
Divided into 3 parts by pectoralis minor
Thoracoacromial, lateral thoracic, subscapular a.
Anterior and posterior circumflex humeral arteries
postlar.izoh:
🩸 Qo'ltiq arteriyasi (a. axillaris):

📏 1-qovurg'a lateral chetidan katta yumaloq mushak (teres major) pastki chetigacha; undan keyin - A. BRACHIALIS.

🔸 Kichik ko'krak mushagi (pectoralis minor) uni 3 qismga bo'ladi:
1️⃣ mushakdan yuqorida - a. thoracica superior (suprema);
2️⃣ mushak ortida - a. THORACOACROMIALIS va a. THORACICA LATERALIS (ko'krak bezi uchun ham muhim);
3️⃣ mushakdan pastda - a. SUBSCAPULARIS (eng yirik; -> a. thoracodorsalis va a. circumflexa scapulae), a. CIRCUMFLEXA HUMERI ANTERIOR va POSTERIOR.

🧠 Mnemonika (1-2-3 shox): "Screw The Lawyer Save A Patient" - Superior thoracic, Thoracoacromial, Lateral thoracic, Subscapular, Anterior & Posterior circumflex humeral.

💡 Qo'ltiq arteriyasi atrofida yelka chigalining 3 tutami (lateral, medial, posterior) joylashadi - nomlari arteriyaga nisbatan berilgan.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): A. axillaris, a. thoracoacromialis, a. thoracalis lateralis, a. subscapularis, a. circumflexa scapulae.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: Scapular anastomosis and circumflex humeral arteries
bandlar: Anastomosis: suprascapular, dorsal scapular, circumflex scapular a.
Links subclavian and axillary a. -> collateral flow
Posterior circumflex humeral a. + axillary n.: quadrangular space
Both are injured in surgical neck fractures
postlar.izoh:
🔁 Kurak atrofidagi anastomoz:

Kurak suyagi atrofida 3 ta arteriya o'zaro tutashadi:
• kurak usti arteriyasi (a. suprascapularis) - truncus thyrocervicalisdan;
• kurakning orqa (dorsal) arteriyasi (a. transversa colli chuqur shoxi);
• kurakni aylanib o'tuvchi arteriya (a. circumflexa scapulae) - a. subscapularisdan.

✅ Ahamiyati: a. subclavia yoki a. axillarisning proksimal qismi asta-sekin bekilganda, qon bu anastomoz orqali qo'lga yetib boradi (kollateral aylanish).

🔸 Yelkani aylanib o'tuvchi orqa arteriya (a. circumflexa humeri posterior) n. axillaris bilan birga TO'RT TOMONLI teshikdan (teres minor, teres major, triceps uzun boshi va humerus orasida) o'tadi va jarrohlik bo'yni atrofini aylanadi.

💡 USMLE: jarrohlik bo'yni sinishi -> n. axillaris + a. circumflexa humeri posterior shikasti.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz, orqadan): a. transversa scapulae, a. circumflexa scapulae, a. circumflexa humeri posterior.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Brachial a.: continuation of axillary a. below teres major
Profunda brachii runs with radial nerve in the radial groove
Superior and inferior ulnar collateral arteries -> elbow
Divides in cubital fossa into radial and ulnar arteries
postlar.izoh:
🩸 Yelka arteriyasi (a. brachialis):

🔸 Katta yumaloq mushak pastki chetidan boshlanadi, ikki boshli mushakning medial egatida n. medianus bilan birga pastga tushadi.

🌿 Shoxlari:
• YELKANING CHUQUR arteriyasi (a. profunda brachii) - n. RADIALIS bilan birga bilak nervi egatida (sulcus n. radialis) yelka suyagini aylanadi -> o'rta va radial kollateral arteriyalar;
• yuqori va pastki ulnar kollateral arteriyalar - tirsak atrofi to'riga;
• yelka suyagini oziqlantiruvchi arteriya.

📍 Tirsak chuqurchasida (radius bo'yni sathida) a. brachialis -> A. RADIALIS va A. ULNARIS ga bo'linadi.

🩺 Klinik:
• suprakondilyar sinishda a. brachialis shikastlanishi -> bilak ishemiyasi, Volkmann ishemik kontrakturasi;
• qon bosimi shu arteriya ustida o'lchanadi.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): A. brachialis, a. profunda brachii, a. collateralis ulnaris superior/inferior, a. radialis, a. ulnaris.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Radial a. runs laterally under brachioradialis
Ulnar a. is larger, gives the common interosseous artery
Common interosseous -> anterior and posterior interosseous
Recurrent branches form the elbow anastomosis

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Formed mainly by the ulnar artery
Completed by the superficial palmar branch of the radial a.
Lies superficial to flexor tendons, under palmar aponeurosis
Gives common palmar digital arteries
postlar.izoh:
🌈 Yuzaki kaft ravog'i (arcus palmaris superficialis):

🔸 Asosan TIRSAK arteriyasi (a. ulnaris) davomidan hosil bo'ladi; lateral tomondan a. radialisning yuzaki kaft shoxi (ramus palmaris superficialis) bilan tutashadi.

📍 Joylashuvi: kaft aponevrozi ostida, bukuvchi paylar USTIDA (yuzaki) - chuqur ravoqdan distalroq.

🌿 Shoxlari: umumiy kaft barmoq arteriyalari (aa. digitales palmares communes) -> xususiy barmoq arteriyalari.

🩺 Klinik:
• kaftning chuqur kesilgan jarohatlarida kuchli qon ketadi (ikki tomondan to'ladi);
• Allen testi aynan kaft ravog'i orqali a. ulnaris va a. radialis o'zaro tutashganini tekshiradi.

🧠 Eslab qolish: Yuzaki = Ulnar (ikkalasida ham "U"), chuqur = Radial.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): arcus volaris superficialis, a. ulnaris, ramus volaris superficialis a. radialis, aa. digitales volares communes.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Formed mainly by the radial artery
Completed by the deep palmar branch of the ulnar artery
Lies on metacarpal bases, deep to flexor tendons
Gives palmar metacarpal arteries; runs with deep ulnar nerve
postlar.izoh:
🌈 Chuqur kaft ravog'i (arcus palmaris profundus):

🔸 Asosan BILAK arteriyasi (a. radialis) dan hosil bo'ladi: a. radialis bilak orqasidan "anatomik tamakidon" orqali o'tib, birinchi orqa suyaklararo mushak boshlari orasidan kaftga chiqadi; medialda a. ulnarisning chuqur shoxi bilan tutashadi.

📍 Joylashuvi: kaft suyaklari asoslari ustida, bukuvchi paylar ORTIDA, yuzaki ravoqdan proksimalroq.

🌿 Shoxlari:
• kaft-kaft (palmar metacarpal) arteriyalari;
• teshib o'tuvchi (perforant) shoxlar - panja orqasiga;
• bosh barmoqning asosiy arteriyasi.

💡 Chuqur ravoq bilan birga n. ulnarisning CHUQUR shoxi yotadi.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz, chuqur qavat): arcus volaris profundus, a. radialis, ramus volaris profundus a. ulnaris, rami perforantes, aa. metacarpeae volares.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Stenosis of subclavian a. proximal to the vertebral a.
Reversed flow in ipsilateral vertebral a. on arm exercise
Arm ischemia, pain, paresthesia + dizziness, vertigo
>15 mm Hg difference in systolic BP between the arms

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Tests patency of radial and ulnar arteries via palmar arch
Clench fist, occlude both arteries, open pale hand
Release ulnar a.: color returns <5-15 s = ulnar a. patent
Done before radial artery cannulation or harvesting
postlar.izoh:
🖐 Allen testi:

Maqsad: a. radialis yoki a. ulnaris bekilganini va kaft ravog'i orqali kollateral oqim borligini tekshirish.

🔸 Bosqichlar:
1. bemor mushtini qattiq siqadi - kaftdan qon haydaladi;
2. shifokor ikkala arteriyani (radial va ulnar) barmoqlari bilan bosadi;
3. bemor kaftini ochadi - kaft OQARGAN;
4. bitta arteriya qo'yib yuboriladi (odatda ulnar), ikkinchisi bosilgan holda qoladi.

✅ Rang 5-15 soniyada qaytsa - qo'yib yuborilgan arteriya ochiq va ravoq ishlaydi.
❌ Rang qaytmasa - qo'yib yuborilgan arteriya (yoki ravoq) bekilgan.

📌 Darsdagi misol: ulnar arteriya bosilgan, radial qo'yib yuborilgan - qon qaytmasa, a. RADIALIS bekilgan.

💡 Amaliyot: a. radialisga kateter qo'yish, arterial qon olish, AV-fistula yoki koronar shunt uchun a. radialisni olishdan oldin bajariladi.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

postlar.sarlavha: Superficial veins of the upper limb
bandlar: Begin from the dorsal venous network of the hand
Cephalic vein: lateral -> deltopectoral groove -> axillary v.
Basilic vein: medial -> pierces fascia -> axillary v.
Median cubital vein links them - common venipuncture site
postlar.izoh:
🩸 Qo'lning yuzaki venalari:

🔸 Panja orqasidagi venoz to'rdan (rete venosum dorsale manus) boshlanadi.

1️⃣ V. CEPHALICA (bosh venasi) - LATERAL (bosh barmoq) tomondan yuqoriga ko'tariladi, deltasimon-ko'krak egatidan o'tib, klavipektoral uchburchakda fassiyani teshib, v. axillarisga quyiladi.

2️⃣ V. BASILICA (asosiy vena) - MEDIAL tomondan; yelka o'rtasida chuqur fassiyani teshadi va yelka venalari bilan qo'shilib v. axillarisni hosil qiladi.

3️⃣ V. MEDIANA CUBITI - tirsak chuqurchasida ikkalasini qiyshiq tutashtiradi; vena punksiyasi va qon olish uchun eng qulay joy.

💡 V. cephalica gemodializ uchun AV-fistulada ishlatiladi; v. basilica - PICC kateter uchun.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): v. cephalica, v. basilica, v. mediana cubiti, v. mediana antebrachii, n. cutaneus antibrachii lateralis/medialis.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Most common access: radial artery + cephalic vein (wrist)
Arterial pressure dilates and thickens (arterializes) the vein
Usually created on the non-dominant arm
Check ulnar flow (Allen test) before surgery; thrill = patent

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

postlar.sarlavha: Compartments of the arm and forearm
bandlar: Arm: intermuscular septa -> anterior and posterior compartments
Forearm: interosseous membrane + septum -> two compartments
Anterior arm = musculocutaneous n.; posterior = radial n.
Anterior forearm = median (+ulnar) n.; posterior = radial n.
postlar.izoh:
📦 Yelka va bilak kompartmentlari:

🔸 YELKA: medial va lateral mushaklararo to'siqlar (septa intermuscularia) uni ikkiga bo'ladi:
• OLDINGI (bukuvchi) - coracobrachialis, brachialis, biceps brachii -> n. MUSCULOCUTANEUS;
• ORQA (yozuvchi) - triceps brachii -> n. RADIALIS.

🔸 BILAK: suyaklararo parda (membrana interossea) va to'siq ikkiga bo'ladi:
• OLDINGI (bukuvchi-pronator) - asosan n. MEDIANUS; FCU va FDP ning medial yarmi - n. ULNARIS;
• ORQA (yozuvchi-supinator) - barchasi n. RADIALIS (asosan chuqur shoxi = n. interosseus posterior).

🧠 Qoida: oldingi = bukuvchilar, orqa = yozuvchilar; barcha yozuvchilar - n. radialis.

💡 USMLE: bilak suyaklari sinishi yoki ezilishidan keyin kompartment sindromi - passiv cho'zishda kuchli og'riq; davo - fassiotomiya.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

postlar.sarlavha: Anterior arm muscles: biceps, coracobrachialis, brachialis
bandlar: Coracobrachialis, brachialis, biceps brachii
All innervated by the musculocutaneous nerve
Biceps: flexes elbow, strongest supinator of the flexed forearm
Brachialis: pure elbow flexor (inserts on ulnar tuberosity)

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Only muscle of the posterior arm compartment
Long head (infraglenoid tubercle), lateral and medial heads
Inserts on olecranon; main extensor of the elbow
Innervated by the radial nerve (C6-C8)
postlar.izoh:
💪 Yelkaning orqa kompartmenti - uch boshli mushak (m. triceps brachii):

🔸 Boshlari:
• UZUN boshi - kurak bo'g'im osti do'mbog'idan (ikki bo'g'imli: yelka bo'g'imida ham ishlaydi);
• LATERAL boshi - bilak nervi egatidan yuqorida, yelka suyagi orqa yuzasidan;
• MEDIAL boshi - egatdan pastda.

🔸 Yopishishi: tirsak o'simtasi (olecranon).
🔸 Vazifasi: tirsakni YOZADI (asosiy yozuvchi); uzun boshi yelkani orqaga tortadi.
⚡️ Innervatsiya: n. RADIALIS (C6-C8); reflex - C7.

💡 USMLE: n. radialis triceps shoxlarini bilak nervi egatiga kirishdan OLDIN beradi. Shuning uchun yelka suyagi tanasi sinishida tirsakni yozish (triceps) odatda SAQLANADI, qo'ltiqdagi siqilishda esa yo'qoladi.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz, orqadan): m. triceps brachii (caput laterale, caput longum), m. teres minor.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Three layers: superficial, intermediate, deep
Superficial: FCU, palmaris longus, FCR, pronator teres
Common origin: medial epicondyle (common flexor tendon)
All median n. except FCU (ulnar n.)

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Only muscle of the intermediate layer
Humero-ulnar head: medial epicondyle + coronoid process
Radial head: anterior oblique line of the radius
Flexes PIP joints (and MCP) of fingers 2-5; median nerve
postlar.izoh:
💪 Oraliq qavat - barmoqlarning yuza bukuvchisi (FDS; eski nomi m. flexor digitorum sublimis):

🔸 Ikki boshi bor:
• YELKA-TIRSAK boshi - medial epikondil va tirsak suyagi tojsimon o'simtasining medial chetidan;
• BILAK boshi - radiusning oldingi qiyshiq chizig'idan.
Ikki bosh orasidagi "ko'prik" ostidan n. medianus va a. ulnaris o'tadi.

🔸 Yopishishi: 4 ta pay kaft usti kanali orqali II-V barmoqlarning O'RTA falangalariga; har bir pay ikkiga ajralib, ostidan FDP payini o'tkazadi.

🔸 Vazifasi: PIP bo'g'imlarini bukadi (yana MCP va kaft ustini).
⚡️ Innervatsiya: n. MEDIANUS (C8, T1).

🧪 Klinik test: boshqa barmoqlar yozilgan holda ushlab turiladi - bemor tekshirilayotgan barmoqni PIP da buka olsa, FDS butun.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): m. flexor digitorum sublimis (caput humerale, caput radiale), tuberositas radii.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: Deep flexors: FDP, FPL, pronator quadratus
bandlar: FDP: DIP flexion of fingers 2-5; lateral half median (AIN), medial half ulnar
FPL: flexes the thumb IP joint; anterior interosseous n.
Pronator quadratus: pronation; anterior interosseous n.
AIN lesion: weak pinch, cannot make an 'OK' sign
postlar.izoh:
💪 Chuqur qavat - 3 ta mushak:

1️⃣ BARMOQLARNING CHUQUR BUKUVCHISI (FDP) - tirsak suyagi va suyaklararo pardadan; 4 pay II-V barmoqlarning DISTAL falangalariga; DIP ni bukadi (MCP va kaft ustini ham).
⚡️ Ikki nervli: lateral yarmi (II-III) - n. medianus (n. interosseus anterior), medial yarmi (IV-V) - n. ULNARIS.

2️⃣ BOSH BARMOQNING UZUN BUKUVCHISI (FPL) - radius va suyaklararo pardadan; bosh barmoq distal falangasiga; IP bo'g'imini bukadi; n. interosseus anterior.

3️⃣ KVADRAT PRONATOR (pronator quadratus) - tirsak suyagi distal qismidan radiusga; asosiy pronator; n. interosseus anterior.

🧪 Test: FDP butunligini tekshirish - PIP ushlab turilganda DIP bukilishi.

💡 USMLE: n. interosseus anterior shikasti - sezgi yo'qolmaydi, lekin bosh va ko'rsatkich barmoq uchlari bilan "O" (OK) belgisini yasay olmaydi (FPL va FDP-II zaif).

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): m. flexor digitorum profundus, m. flexor pollicis longus, m. pronator quadratus.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Posterior compartment: superficial and deep layers
Brachioradialis: flexes elbow in mid-pronation; radial n.
ECRL: extends and abducts wrist (base of MC II); radial n.
ECRB: base of MC II-III; deep branch of radial n.
postlar.izoh:
💪 Bilakning orqa kompartmenti - yuza qavat (1-qism, "radial guruh"):

Orqa mushaklar 2 qavatda: yuza va chuqur. Hammasi n. RADIALIS (yoki uning shoxlari).

1️⃣ YELKA-BILAK mushagi (brachioradialis) - lateral suprakondilyar qirraning proksimal qismidan radius distal uchiga; bilak YARIM PRONATSIYADA bo'lganda tirsakni bukadi ("pivo ichish" mushagi). Yozuvchi guruhda bo'lsa ham, BUKADI! n. radialis (C5, C6) - bo'linishidan oldin.

2️⃣ KAFT USTINING UZUN BILAK YOZUVCHISI (ECRL) - suprakondilyar qirraning distal qismidan II kaft suyagi asosiga; kaft ustini yozadi va radial abduktsiya; n. radialis (C6, C7).

3️⃣ KAFT USTINING QISQA BILAK YOZUVCHISI (ECRB) - umumiy yozuvchi paydan II-III kaft suyaklari asosiga; yozadi va abduktsiya; n. radialisning CHUQUR shoxi (supinatorga kirishdan oldin).

💡 "Tennis elbow" (lateral epikondilit) - asosan ECRB payining zo'riqishi.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz, radial tomondan): m. brachioradialis, m. extensor carpi radialis longus/brevis.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: Posterior forearm: ED, EDM, ECU, anconeus
bandlar: Common origin: lateral epicondyle (common extensor tendon)
Extensor digitorum: extends fingers 2-5 via extensor hoods
EDM extends little finger; ECU extends and adducts wrist
ED, EDM, ECU: posterior interosseous n.; anconeus: radial n.
postlar.izoh:
💪 Bilakning orqa kompartmenti - yuza qavat (2-qism):

Bular LATERAL EPIKONDILDAN (umumiy yozuvchi pay) boshlanadi:

1️⃣ BARMOQLARNING UMUMIY YOZUVCHISI (extensor digitorum) - 4 pay "yozuvchi qalpoqcha" (extensor hood) orqali II-V barmoqlarning o'rta va distal falangalariga; barmoqlarni va kaft ustini yozadi.

2️⃣ JIMJILOQ YOZUVCHISI (extensor digiti minimi) - V barmoq qalpoqchasiga; jimjiloqni yozadi.

3️⃣ KAFT USTINING TIRSAK YOZUVCHISI (ECU) - epikondil va tirsak suyagi orqa chetidan V kaft suyagi asosiga; kaft ustini yozadi va ULNAR adduktsiya qiladi.

⚡️ Uchalasi - n. interosseus posterior (C7, C8).

4️⃣ TIRSAK mushagi (anconeus) - lateral epikondildan olecranonga; tirsakni yozishga yordam beradi, pronatsiyada tirsak suyagini abduktsiya qiladi; n. radialis (triceps medial boshi shoxi orqali).

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz, orqadan): m. extensor digitorum communis, m. extensor carpi ulnaris, m. anconaeus, epicondylus lateralis.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: Deep extensors: supinator and the thumb/index extensors
bandlar: Supinator: supination; PIN passes through it
APL: abducts thumb at CMC (base of MC I)
EPB: extends MCP; EPL: extends IP joint of thumb
Extensor indicis: extends index finger; all PIN (C7-C8)
postlar.izoh:
💪 Bilakning orqa kompartmenti - chuqur qavat (5 ta mushak):

1️⃣ SUPINATOR - lateral epikondil, boylamlar va tirsak suyagi supinator qirrasidan radiusga; supinatsiya. n. interosseus posterior (PIN) mushak ICHIDAN (ikki qavati orasidan) o'tadi - shu yerda siqilishi mumkin.

2️⃣ BOSH BARMOQNI UZOQLASHTIRUVCHI UZUN mushak (APL) - I kaft suyagi asosiga; CMC da abduktsiya.

3️⃣ BOSH BARMOQNING QISQA YOZUVCHISI (EPB) - proksimal falanga asosiga; MCP ni yozadi.

4️⃣ BOSH BARMOQNING UZUN YOZUVCHISI (EPL) - distal falanga asosiga; IP bo'g'imini (va MCP, CMC ni) yozadi.

5️⃣ KO'RSATKICH BARMOQ YOZUVCHISI (extensor indicis) - II barmoq qalpoqchasiga.

⚡️ Hammasi - n. interosseus posterior (C7, C8); supinator - C6, C7.

💡 APL, EPB va EPL paylari "anatomik tamakidon"ni chegaralaydi; APL+EPB pay qinining yallig'lanishi - de Quervain tenosinoviti.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): m. supinator, m. abductor pollicis longus, m. extensor pollicis brevis/longus, m. extensor indicis.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: Intrinsic hand: adductor pollicis and palmaris brevis
bandlar: Adductor pollicis: oblique and transverse heads
Inserts on thumb proximal phalanx; adducts the thumb
Palmaris brevis: in skin of hypothenar; improves grip
Both: ulnar n. (deep branch / superficial branch)

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Four bipennate muscles between the metacarpals
Abduct index, middle and ring fingers at the MCP joints
Middle finger has two (abducts to either side)
Deep branch of ulnar nerve (C8, T1)
postlar.izoh:
✋ Orqa suyaklararo mushaklar (mm. interossei dorsales):

🔸 4 ta, ikki patli; qo'shni kaft suyaklarining yonma-yon yuzalaridan boshlanadi.

🔸 Yopishishi: proksimal falanga asosi va yozuvchi qalpoqcha - II, III (ikki tomondan) va IV barmoqlarga.

🔸 Vazifasi: barmoqlarni O'RTA (III) barmoq o'qidan UZOQLASHTIRADI (abduktsiya, MCP da). O'rta barmoqning ikkita orqa interosseyi bor - uni ikkala tomonga ham "uzoqlashtiradi". Bosh barmoq va jimjiloqning o'z abduktorlari bor (APB/APL va ADM).

🔸 Qo'shimcha: lumbrikallar kabi MCP ni bukadi, IP ni yozadi.

⚡️ Innervatsiya: n. ULNARIS chuqur shoxi (C8, T1).

🧠 Mnemonika: DAB = Dorsals ABduct.

🧪 Test: barmoqlarni yoyish va qarshilikka qarshi ushlab turish; n. ulnaris shikastida yo'qoladi.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz, panja orqasi): mm. interossei dorsales, os metacarpale V.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Three (or four) unipennate muscles
Adduct fingers toward the middle finger at the MCP joints
Insert on thumb, index, ring and little finger hoods
Deep branch of ulnar nerve (C8, T1)
postlar.izoh:
✋ Kaft suyaklararo mushaklari (mm. interossei palmares / volares):

🔸 3 ta (ba'zan 4 ta) bir patli mushak; kaft suyaklarining yon yuzalaridan.

🔸 Yopishishi: bosh barmoq (proksimal falanga), II, IV va V barmoqlar qalpoqchalariga - O'RTA barmoqqa yopishmaydi (u o'q).

🔸 Vazifasi: barmoqlarni O'RTA barmoq tomon YAQINLASHTIRADI (adduktsiya, MCP da); MCP ni bukishga va IP ni yozishga ham yordam beradi.

⚡️ Innervatsiya: n. ULNARIS chuqur shoxi (C8, T1).

🧠 Mnemonika: PAD = Palmars ADduct.

🧪 Test: barmoqlar orasiga qog'oz qo'yib qisish ("card test") - n. ulnaris shikastida bemor qog'ozni ushlay olmaydi.

💡 USMLE: interosseylar yo'qolsa - barmoqlarni yoyish ham, yig'ish ham yo'qoladi -> n. ulnaris (chuqur shox) yoki T1 (Klumpke).

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): mm. interossei volares, mm. interossei dorsales, mm. lumbricales (kesilgan).

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Four muscles arising from the tendons of FDP
Pass palmar to MCP joints into the extensor hoods
Flex MCP joints while extending PIP and DIP joints
1st-2nd: median nerve; 3rd-4th: deep ulnar nerve
postlar.izoh:
✋ Chuvalchangsimon mushaklar (mm. lumbricales):

🔸 4 ta; o'ziga xosligi - suyakdan emas, FDP PAYLARIDAN boshlanadi.

🔸 Yo'li: MCP bo'g'imining KAFT tomonidan o'tib, barmoqning radial tomonidan yozuvchi qalpoqchaga (orqa aponevrozga) yopishadi.

🔸 Vazifasi: MCP ni BUKADI va bir vaqtda PIP va DIP ni YOZADI - "upstroke" (yozish, kartani ushlash) holati.

⚡️ Innervatsiya (FDP kabi ikki nervli):
• 1- va 2-lumbrikal (lateral) - n. MEDIANUS (barmoq shoxlari);
• 3- va 4-lumbrikal (medial) - n. ULNARIS chuqur shoxi.

🩺 Klinik:
• n. ulnaris shikasti -> 3-4-lumbrikal yo'qoladi -> IV-V barmoqlarda "tirnoq" (MCP giperekstenziya, IP bukilish);
• n. medianus shikasti -> 1-2-lumbrikal yo'qoladi -> II-III barmoqlarda (benediction).

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): mm. lumbricales, tendines m. flexoris digitorum profundi, m. opponens pollicis.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

bandlar: Extensor digitorum tendon expands into the dorsal hood
Lumbricals and interossei insert into the hood
Pull palmar to the MCP axis but dorsal to PIP/DIP
Result: MCP flexion + IP extension; loss -> claw
postlar.izoh:
⚙️ Yozuvchi qalpoqcha (extensor hood) va barmoq mexanikasi:

🔸 Barmoqlarning umumiy yozuvchisi payi proksimal falanga ustida kengayib, uchburchak "qalpoqcha" (aponeurosis dorsalis) hosil qiladi; u o'rta va distal falangalar asosiga yopishadi.

🔸 Qalpoqchaga yon tomondan lumbrikal va suyaklararo mushaklar qo'shiladi.

🧩 Nima uchun ular MCP ni bukadi, IP ni yozadi?
• ularning paylari MCP bo'g'imi o'qidan KAFT tomondan o'tadi -> MCP bukiladi;
• keyin qalpoqcha orqali PIP va DIP o'qidan ORQA tomondan o'tadi -> IP bo'g'imlar yoziladi.

🩺 Bu mexanizm buzilsa (n. ulnaris, T1 shikasti):
• MCP ni barmoqlarning umumiy yozuvchisi qarshiliksiz giperekstenziya qiladi;
• IP ni FDS/FDP bukadi;
• natija - "TIRNOQSIMON PANJA" (claw hand).

💡 Lumbrikallar bilan yozish holati: MCP bukilgan, PIP va DIP to'g'ri ("upstroke").

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Opponens pollicis, abductor pollicis brevis, flexor pollicis brevis
Arise from flexor retinaculum, scaphoid and trapezium tubercles
Recurrent branch of median nerve (C8, T1)
FPB deep head is often supplied by the ulnar nerve
postlar.izoh:
👍 Bosh barmoq tepaligi (tenar) mushaklari:

1️⃣ BOSH BARMOQNI QARAMA-QARSHI QO'YUVCHI mushak (m. opponens pollicis) - trapetsiya do'mbog'i va retinakulumdan I kaft suyagiga; bosh barmoqni ichkariga buradi - OPPOZITSIYA.

2️⃣ BOSH BARMOQNI UZOQLASHTIRUVCHI QISQA mushak (APB) - qayiqsimon va trapetsiya do'mboqlari va retinakulumdan proksimal falangaga; MCP da abduktsiya.

3️⃣ BOSH BARMOQNING QISQA BUKUVCHISI (FPB) - trapetsiya do'mbog'i va retinakulumdan proksimal falangaga; MCP ni bukadi. Yuza boshi - n. medianus, CHUQUR boshi ko'pincha n. ULNARIS.

⚡️ Innervatsiya: n. medianusning QAYTUVCHI (recurrent, motor) shoxi (C8, T1).

🧠 Mnemonika: tenar va gipotenar guruhlar bir xil ishni bajaradi - OAF: Oppose, Abduct, Flex.

💡 Tenar atrofiyasi - n. medianus shikastining (karpal tunnel) belgisi; "maymun panjasi".

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): m. abductor pollicis brevis, m. flexor pollicis brevis, m. opponens pollicis, m. adductor pollicis.

🤙 Jimjiloq tepaligi (gipotenar) mushaklari:

3️⃣ JIMJILOQNING QISQA BUKUVCHISI (m. flexor digiti minimi brevis) - ilmoqli suyak ilmog'i va retinakulumdan proksimal falangaga; MCP ni bukadi.

⚡️ Hammasi - n. ULNARIS chuqur shoxi (C8, T1).

💡 Gipotenar atrofiyasi - n. ulnaris shikastining belgisi (masalan, Guyon kanalida - velosipedchilar).

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): m. abductor digiti V, m. flexor digiti V brevis, m. opponens digiti V, os pisiforme.

📐 Yelka chigali va narvonsimon mushaklar oralig'i:

🔸 Yelka chigali POYALARI va A. SUBCLAVIA oldingi va o'rta narvonsimon mushaklar (mm. scaleni anterior et medius) ORASIDAN (narvonsimon uchburchak) o'tadi.

🔸 V. SUBCLAVIA esa oldingi narvonsimon mushak OLDIDAN (anteromedialda) o'tadi - uchburchakka kirmaydi.

🔸 Chigalning o'mrov USTI qismi - ildiz va poyalar (bo'yinda); o'mrov OSTI qismi - tutamlar va shoxlar (qo'ltiqda).

🩺 Klinik:
• ko'krak qafasidan chiqish sindromi (thoracic outlet) - bo'yin qovurg'asi yoki narvonsimon mushak gipertrofiyasi pastki poyani (C8-T1) va a. subclaviani siqadi: qo'l medial tomoni paresteziyasi, panja mushaklari atrofiyasi, puls susayishi;
• interskalen blokada - anesteziyada aynan shu oraliqqa qilinadi (diafragma nervi ham blokadaga tushishi mumkin).

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): plexus brachialis (pars supraclavicularis), m. scalenus anterior/medius, a. subclavia, n. phrenicus, n. thoracalis longus.

postlar.izoh:
🕸 Yelka chigalining o'mrov osti qismi (qo'ltiqda):

Tutamlar qo'ltiq arteriyasining 2-qismini (pectoralis minor ortida) uch tomondan o'raydi - nomlari shunga ko'ra.

🔸 LATERAL tutam -> n. MUSCULOCUTANEUS, n. medianusning lateral ildizi, lateral ko'krak nervi.

🔸 MEDIAL tutam -> n. ULNARIS, n. medianusning medial ildizi, medial ko'krak nervi, yelka va bilakning medial teri nervlari.
➡️ Ikki ildiz arteriya oldida "M" harfini hosil qiladi (musculocutaneus - medianus - ulnaris).

🔸 ORQA tutam -> n. AXILLARIS, n. RADIALIS, yuqori va pastki kurak osti nervlari, n. thoracodorsalis (latissimus dorsi).

🧠 Orqa tutam shoxlari: "STAR" - Subscapulars, Thoracodorsal, Axillary, Radial.

💡 Qo'ltiqdagi jarohatlar (pichoq, yelka chiqishi, qo'ltiq tayoqchasi) bir nechta tutam/shoxni birga shikastlashi mumkin.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): n. medianus, n. ulnaris, n. musculocutaneus, n. thoracodorsalis, n. thoracalis longus, A. axillaris.

bandlar: Cause: lateral traction on neck (shoulder dystocia, trauma)
Arm adducted + medially rotated (deltoid, supraspinatus, infraspinatus)
Forearm extended + pronated (biceps, brachialis)
'Waiter's tip'; hand muscles spared; biceps reflex lost
postlar.izoh:
👶 Erb-Dyushen falaji - yuqori poya (C5-C6) shikasti:

🔸 Sabab: bosh va yelka orasidagi burchakning keskin kattalashishi - tug'ruqda yelka distotsiyasi (bosh yon tomonga tortiladi), mototsikldan yiqilish.

🔸 Zaiflashgan mushaklar va natijaviy holat:
• deltasimon va supraspinatus -> qo'l YAQINLASHGAN (adduktsiya);
• infraspinatus -> qo'l ICHKARIGA buralgan (medial rotatsiya);
• biceps va brachialis -> tirsak YOZILGAN;
• biceps (supinator) -> bilak PRONATSIYADA.

➡️ Natija: "ofitsiant choychaqa so'raydi" (waiter's tip) holati.

🔸 Sezgi: yelka va bilak lateral yuzasida kamayadi; biceps refleksi yo'q.
🔸 PANJA mushaklari ishlaydi (C8-T1 butun).

💡 USMLE: yangi tug'ilgan chaqaloq, katta vazn, yelka distotsiyasi, qo'l tanaga yopishgan, ichkariga buralgan, kaft orqaga qaragan - Erb.

bandlar: Cause: forceful upward traction / abduction of the arm
Total claw hand: all intrinsic hand muscles lost
Sensory loss on medial forearm and hand
T1 sympathetic involvement -> ipsilateral Horner syndrome
postlar.izoh:
✋ Klumpke falaji - pastki poya (C8-T1) shikasti:

🔸 Sabab: qo'lning keskin yuqoriga tortilishi/abduktsiyasi - tug'ruqda qo'ldan tortish, yiqilayotganda daraxt shoxini ushlab qolish; shuningdek bo'yin qovurg'asi, o'pka cho'qqisi (Pancoast) o'smasi.

🔸 Belgilari:
• panjaning BARCHA ichki mushaklari (lumbrikallar, interosseylar, tenar, gipotenar) zaiflashadi -> TO'LIQ "tirnoqsimon panja" (barcha barmoqlar);
• bilak va panjaning MEDIAL yuzasi sezgisi yo'qoladi (C8, T1 dermatomlari);
• FCU, FDP medial qismi ham zaif bo'lishi mumkin.

👁 T1 ildizi orqali simpatik tolalar (yuqori ko'krak ganglionidan bo'yin simpatik zanjiriga) zararlansa - o'sha tomonda HORNER sindromi: ptoz, mioz, angidroz.

🧠 Farq: Erb - yuqori, "qo'l holati"; Klumpke - pastki, "panja + Horner".

💡 USMLE: Pancoast o'smasi + panja atrofiyasi + Horner - pastki poya.

bandlar: Long thoracic n. (C5-C7) supplies serratus anterior
Injury: mastectomy (axillary dissection), stab wound
Winged scapula when pushing against a wall
Cannot abduct the arm above the horizontal
postlar.izoh:
🪽 N. thoracicus longus va "qanotsimon kurak":

🔸 N. thoracicus longus (C5, C6, C7 ildizlaridan) - ko'krak qafasining yon devorida, oldingi tishli mushak (m. serratus anterior) yuzasida pastga tushadi va faqat shu mushakni innervatsiya qiladi.

🔸 Serratus anterior vazifasi: kurakni ko'krak qafasiga bosib turadi, oldinga suradi (protraksiya) va yuqoriga buradi - qo'lni 90° dan YUQORI ko'tarish uchun zarur.

🩺 Shikast sabablari:
• mastektomiya, qo'ltiq limfa tugunlarini olib tashlash;
• ko'krak yon devoriga pichoq jarohati, plevral drenaj;
• og'ir yuk ko'tarish (yelka sumkasi).

🔸 Belgilar: bemor qo'llari bilan devorga tiralganda kurakning medial cheti va pastki burchagi "qanot" kabi ko'tariladi; qo'lni gorizontaldan yuqori ko'tara olmaydi.

💡 USMLE: "mastektomiyadan keyin kurak devorga tiralganda bo'rtib chiqadi" - n. thoracicus longus.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): m. serratus anterior, scapula, m. scalenus anterior/medius.

bandlar: Radial n. + profunda brachii run in the radial groove

postlar.izoh:
🦴 Yelka suyagi tanasi sinishi va n. radialis:

🔸 N. radialis a. profunda brachii bilan birga yelka suyagi orqa yuzasidagi BILAK NERVI EGATIDA (sulcus n. radialis) suyakka bevosita tegib, spiral bo'ylab aylanadi - shuning uchun tana (o'rta uchdan bir) sinishida eng ko'p shikastlanadigan nerv.

🩺 Belgilar:
• kaft usti va MCP bo'g'imlarini yozish yo'qoladi - BILAK OSILISHI (wrist drop);
• supinatsiya zaiflashadi (m. supinator yo'qoladi, biceps qoladi);
• bilak orqasi va bosh barmoq orqasi sezgisi kamayadi.

✅ SAQLANADI:
• triceps (tirsakni yozish) - uning shoxlari egatdan yuqorida chiqadi;
• yelka orqasi sezgisi (yelkaning orqa teri nervi ham yuqoridan chiqadi).

💡 USMLE: "yelka o'rtasi sinishi + bilak osilishi, lekin tirsakni yoza oladi" - n. radialis egatda.

🖼 Rasmda (Sobotta): sulcus nervi radialis, corpus humeri, collum chirurgicum.

postlar.sarlavha: Radial nerve below the elbow: PIN and superficial branch
bandlar: At lateral epicondyle divides into deep (PIN) and superficial branches
PIN passes through supinator: finger drop, no sensory loss
ECRL spared -> radial deviation on wrist extension
Superficial branch: sensation of dorsum of thumb / 1st web space
postlar.izoh:
⚡️ N. radialis tirsakdan pastda:

🔸 Lateral epikondil sathida ikki shoxga bo'linadi:

1️⃣ CHUQUR shox -> supinator ichidan o'tib, N. INTEROSSEUS POSTERIOR (PIN) bo'ladi; orqa kompartmentning ko'p mushaklarini (ED, EDM, ECU, APL, EPB, EPL, EI) innervatsiya qiladi.
• Shikast: supinator ichida siqilish ("radial tunnel"), radius boshchasi chiqishi, takroriy pronatsiya/supinatsiya (otvertka bilan ishlash).
• Belgi: BARMOQLAR OSILISHI (finger drop); SEZGI YO'QOLMAYDI (PIN sof motor).
• ECRL (va brachioradialis) yuqoridan innervatsiya olgani uchun saqlanadi -> kaft usti yozilganda RADIAL tomonga og'adi.

2️⃣ YUZAKI shox -> brachioradialis ostida pastga tushib, panja orqasining lateral qismiga sezgi beradi.
• Shikast: kaft usti kesilishi, tor bilaguzuk/kishan - faqat bosh barmoq orqasi va 1-barmoqlararo oraliqda paresteziya.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): ramus profundus et superficialis n. radialis, m. supinator, n. interosseus [antibrachii] dorsalis.

bandlar: Lateral + medial cord roots; runs with brachial a.
Supracondylar fracture -> proximal lesion
'Hand of benediction' when making a fist

bandlar: Distal lesion: carpal tunnel syndrome, wrist laceration
Ape hand: loss of opposition, thenar atrophy
Lateral 3.5 digits lose palmar sensation; palm often spared
No benediction hand; wrist flexion and pronation normal
postlar.izoh:
⚡️ O'rta nerv kaft usti sathida (distal shikast):

🔸 Sabablar: KARPAL TUNNEL sindromi (homiladorlik, gipotireoz, akromegaliya, revmatoid artrit, diabet, amiloidoz, takroriy harakatlar), kaft usti kesilishi.

🩺 Belgilar:
• bosh barmoq OPPOZITSIYASI yo'qoladi -> "MAYMUN PANJASI" (ape hand);
• 1-2-lumbrikallar yo'qoladi;
• TENAR atrofiyasi (tepalik yassilanadi);
• lateral 3,5 barmoqning kaft yuzasida sezgi yo'qoladi; kaftning lateral qismi ko'pincha SAQLANADI - teri (palmar) shoxi kanal oldidan, retinakulum ustidan o'tadi.

✅ Farqi: kaft usti bukilishi, barmoqlar bukilishi va pronatsiya NORMAL; "duo panja" YO'Q (bilak mushaklari tirsak sathida innervatsiya olgan).

🧪 Tinel (kanal ustiga urish) va Phalen (kaft ustini bukib ushlab turish) - paresteziya.

💡 Kechasi kuchayadigan uvishish, bemor qo'lini silkitadi.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): n. medianus lig. carpi transversum ostida, nn. digitales volares communes, ramus superficialis n. radialis.

postlar.sarlavha: Recurrent branch of the median nerve
bandlar: Motor branch to the thenar muscles ('million-dollar nerve')
Arises at distal edge of flexor retinaculum, curves back
Superficial palm laceration -> ape hand
Loss of opposition, abduction, flexion of thumb; NO sensory loss
postlar.izoh:
⚡️ O'rta nervning qaytuvchi (recurrent) shoxi:

🔸 Retinakulumning distal chetidan chiqib, ORQAGA qaytib (recurrens) tenar mushaklariga kiradi; teri ostida juda yuzaki yotadi - shuning uchun "million dollarlik nerv" deyiladi (shikasti bosh barmoq funksiyasini yo'qotadi).

🔸 Innervatsiya qiladi: m. opponens pollicis, m. abductor pollicis brevis, m. flexor pollicis brevis (yuza boshi).

🩺 Shikast: kaftning yuzaki kesilishi (shisha, pichoq), tenar sohasidagi jarrohlik.

🔸 Belgilar:
• tenar guruh funksiyasi yo'qoladi: bosh barmoq oppozitsiyasi, abduktsiyasi va MCP bukilishi;
• "MAYMUN PANJASI" - bosh barmoq boshqa barmoqlar bilan bir tekislikda;
• SEZGI YO'QOLMAYDI - shox sof motor.

💡 USMLE: "kaftga shisha kirgan, bosh barmoqni boshqa barmoqlarga tekkiza olmaydi, sezgi normal" - n. medianusning qaytuvchi shoxi.

Injury: medial epicondyle fracture, cubital tunnel

postlar.sarlavha: Hand signs: benediction vs ape hand vs claw
bandlar: Benediction: proximal median lesion, seen when making a fist
Ape hand: median at wrist / recurrent branch, thumb in palm plane
Ulnar claw: distal ulnar lesion, seen when extending fingers

postlar.izoh:
🖐 Panja belgilari - qiyosiy jadval:

1️⃣ "DUO QILUVCHI PANJA" (hand of benediction) - n. MEDIANUS proksimal (suprakondilyar). Musht qilishga URINGANDA II-III barmoqlar to'g'ri qoladi (FDS, FDP-lateral yo'q).

2️⃣ "MAYMUN PANJASI" (ape hand) - n. medianus kaft usti sathida yoki qaytuvchi shox. Tinch holatda bosh barmoq kaft tekisligida, oppozitsiya yo'q, tenar yassi.

3️⃣ "ULNAR TIRNOQ" (ulnar claw) - n. ULNARIS distal (Guyon, ilmoq). Barmoqlarni YOZISHGA URINGANDA IV-V barmoqlar tirnoqlanadi.

4️⃣ "TO'LIQ TIRNOQ" - pastki poya C8-T1 (Klumpke): barcha barmoqlar, +/- Horner.

5️⃣ "BILAK OSILISHI" (wrist drop) - n. RADIALIS (qo'ltiq, yelka tanasi).

🧠 Duo panja va ulnar tirnoq bir-biriga o'xshaydi, lekin: duo - musht qilishda (median), tirnoq - barmoqlarni yozishda (ulnar).

💡 Ulnar paradoks: tirnoq proksimal shikastda KAMROQ, distal shikastda KO'PROQ.

bandlar: From lateral cord; pierces coracobrachialis
Supplies coracobrachialis, biceps, brachialis
Lesion: loss of elbow flexion, weak supination, lost biceps reflex
Becomes lateral cutaneous nerve of the forearm
postlar.izoh:
⚡️ Teri-mushak nervi (n. musculocutaneus, C5-C7):

🔸 Yo'li: LATERAL tutamdan chiqadi, tumshuq-yelka mushagini (coracobrachialis) teshib o'tadi, biceps va brachialis orasida pastga tushadi; tirsak sathida bilakning LATERAL TERI NERVI bo'lib davom etadi.

🔸 Innervatsiya: yelkaning oldingi kompartmenti - coracobrachialis, biceps brachii, brachialis; teri - bilakning lateral (radial) yuzasi.

🩺 Shikast: yuqori poya siqilishi, qo'ltiq jarohatlari, yelka chiqishi, og'ir yuk ko'tarish (coracobrachialis ichida siqilish) - kam uchraydi.

🔸 Belgilar:
• tirsakni BUKISH keskin zaiflashadi (brachioradialis biroz yordam beradi);
• SUPINATSIYA zaiflashadi (biceps yo'q);
• biceps refleksi (C5-C6) kamayadi;
• bilakning lateral (radial) va orqa-lateral yuzasi sezgisi yo'qoladi.

💡 Darsdagi lezyon #7: "tirsakni bukish qiyin, sezgi o'zgaruvchan" - aynan shu nerv.

🖼 Rasmda (Spalteholz): N. musculocutaneus, m. coracobrachialis, m. biceps brachii, m. brachialis, ramus muscularis f. d. m. biceps.

bandlar: Proximal -> distal: Axillary -> Radial -> Median
Surgical neck: axillary n. + posterior circumflex humeral a.
Midshaft: radial n. + profunda brachii a.
Supracondylar: median n. + brachial a.; medial epicondyle: ulnar n.
postlar.izoh:
🧠 Yelka suyagi sinishlari - A-R-M qoidasi:

Sinish joyi proksimaldan distalga siljiganda shikastlanadigan nerv ham Axillary -> Radial -> Median tartibida almashadi.

1️⃣ JARROHLIK BO'YNI -> n. AXILLARIS + a. circumflexa humeri posterior:
deltasimon yassi, abduktsiya (>15°) yo'q, yelka lateral sezgisi yo'q.

2️⃣ TANA (bilak nervi egati) -> n. RADIALIS + a. profunda brachii:
bilak osilishi, triceps saqlanadi.

3️⃣ SUPRAKONDILYAR (bolalarda ko'p) -> n. MEDIANUS + a. brachialis:
duo panja, pronatsiya yo'q; arteriya shikastida - Volkmann ishemik kontrakturasi.

➕ MEDIAL EPIKONDIL sinishi -> n. ULNARIS: tirnoq panja, barmoqlarni yoyish/yig'ish yo'q.

📋 Nerv ildizlari: axillaris C5-C6, musculocutaneus C5-C7, radialis C5-T1, medianus C5-T1, ulnaris C8-T1.

💡 USMLE: har bir sinish savolida - qaysi nerv VA qaysi arteriya birga shikastlanishini so'rashadi.
