savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old man with a 40-pack-year smoking history has 3 months of right medial forearm numbness and hand weakness. Examination shows atrophy of the intrinsic hand muscles with clawing of all fingers, right ptosis and miosis. Chest x-ray shows a right apical mass.
savollar.savol: Which neural structure is compressed?
savollar.izoh: Pancoast o'smasi pastki poyani (C8-T1) va T1 simpatik tolalarini siqadi: to'liq tirnoq panja + Horner sindromi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 40 quti-yil chekish tarixi bo'lgan 58 yoshli erkakda 3 oydan beri o'ng bilak medial yuzasi uvishadi va panja zaif. Ko'rikda panja ichki mushaklari atrofiyasi va barcha barmoqlar tirnoqlanishi, o'ngda ptoz va mioz. Ko'krak rentgenida o'ng cho'qqida hosila.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi nerv tuzilmasi siqilgan?

savollar.vinyetka: Two weeks after a left modified radical mastectomy with axillary node dissection, a 50-year-old woman cannot comb her hair with the left arm. When she pushes against a wall, the medial border of the left scapula lifts away from the thoracic wall.
savollar.savol: Which nerve was most likely injured?
savollar.izoh: N. thoracicus longus (C5-C7) serratus anteriorni innervatsiya qiladi; shikastida kurak qanotlanadi va qo'l 90 gradusdan yuqori ko'tarilmaydi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Chap tomonlama radikal mastektomiya va qo'ltiq limfa tugunlarini olib tashlashdan 2 hafta o'tib, 50 yoshli ayol chap qo'li bilan sochini taray olmaydi. Devorga tiralganda chap kurakning medial cheti ko'krak devoridan ko'tariladi.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi nerv shikastlangan bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori?

savollar.vinyetka: A 72-year-old woman falls on her outstretched arm. X-ray shows a fracture of the surgical neck of the left humerus. She has flattening of the shoulder contour, cannot abduct the arm beyond 15 degrees, and has numbness over the lateral shoulder.
savollar.savol: Which artery is most likely injured together with the affected nerve?
savollar.izoh: Jarrohlik bo'yni sinishi: n. axillaris va a. circumflexa humeri posterior birga to'rt tomonli teshikdan o'tib, bo'yinni aylanadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 72 yoshli ayol cho'zilgan qo'liga yiqildi. Rentgenda chap yelka suyagi jarrohlik bo'yni sinishi. Yelka konturi yassilangan, qo'lini 15 gradusdan ortiq uzoqlashtira olmaydi, yelka lateral yuzasida uvishish bor.
savollar.savol_uz: Zararlangan nerv bilan birga qaysi arteriya shikastlangan bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori?

savollar.vinyetka: A 30-year-old man sustains a midshaft fracture of the right humerus in a motorcycle crash. He cannot extend his wrist or fingers and has numbness over the dorsum of the thumb. He can still extend his elbow against resistance.
savollar.savol: Where is the nerve most likely injured?
javoblar: Radial nerve in the radial groove
Ulnar nerve at the medial epicondyle
savollar.izoh: Tana sinishi: n. radialis egatda. Triceps shoxlari egatdan yuqorida chiqadi - tirsak yoziladi, lekin bilak osilishi (wrist drop) bor.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 30 yoshli erkak mototsikl avariyasida o'ng yelka suyagi tanasi o'rtasidan sinishini oldi. U kaft usti va barmoqlarini yoza olmaydi, bosh barmoq orqasida uvishish bor. Tirsagini qarshilikka qarshi yoza oladi.
savollar.savol_uz: Nerv qayerda shikastlangan bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori?

savollar.vinyetka: A 45-year-old man has used axillary crutches incorrectly for 6 weeks after a tibial fracture. He now has weakness of elbow extension, wrist drop, weak supination, and sensory loss over the posterior arm, posterior forearm and dorsum of the thumb.
savollar.savol: Which is the most likely site of nerve compression?
javoblar: Radial nerve in the radial groove
savollar.izoh: Qo'ltiq tayoqchasi n. radialisni qo'ltiqda siqadi: triceps ham yo'qoladi, yelka orqasi sezgisi ham buziladi - eng proksimal sath.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 45 yoshli erkak boldir sinishidan keyin 6 hafta davomida qo'ltiq tayoqchalarini noto'g'ri ishlatgan. Hozir tirsakni yozish zaif, bilak osilgan, supinatsiya zaif, yelka orqasi, bilak orqasi va bosh barmoq orqasida sezgi yo'q.
savollar.savol_uz: Nerv siqilishining eng ehtimolli joyi qaysi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 40-year-old carpenter who uses a screwdriver all day cannot extend the fingers of his right hand at the MCP joints. When he extends his wrist, it deviates radially. Sensation of the hand and forearm is normal.
savollar.savol: Which nerve is most likely affected?
javoblar: Radial nerve in the radial groove
Superficial branch of the radial nerve
savollar.izoh: PIN supinator ichida siqiladi: barmoqlar osiladi, sezgi yo'qolmaydi; ECRL saqlangani uchun kaft usti radial og'adi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Kun bo'yi otvertka bilan ishlaydigan 40 yoshli duradgor o'ng qo'l barmoqlarini MCP bo'g'imlarida yoza olmaydi. Kaft ustini yozganda u radial tomonga og'adi. Panja va bilak sezgisi normal.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi nerv zararlangan bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori?

savollar.vinyetka: A 7-year-old boy falls from monkey bars and has a supracondylar fracture of the humerus. When asked to make a fist, the index and middle fingers remain extended. He cannot pronate the forearm, and the thenar eminence and lateral 3.5 digits are numb.
savollar.savol: Which nerve is injured?
savollar.izoh: Suprakondilyar sinish - n. medianus proksimal shikasti: duo panja, pronatsiya yo'q, lateral 3,5 barmoq va tenar sezgisi yo'q.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 7 yoshli bola sport narvonidan yiqilib, yelka suyagi suprakondilyar sinishini oldi. Musht qilishni so'rashganda ko'rsatkich va o'rta barmoqlar to'g'ri qoladi. Bilakni pronatsiya qila olmaydi, tenar tepalik va lateral 3,5 barmoq uvishgan.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi nerv shikastlangan?

savollar.vinyetka: A 32-year-old pregnant woman has numbness and tingling of the right thumb, index and middle fingers that wakes her at night. Tapping over the volar wrist reproduces symptoms. There is mild thenar weakness, but sensation over the lateral palm is normal.
savollar.savol: Why is sensation over the lateral palm preserved?
javoblar: Palmar cutaneous branch runs above the retinaculum
The ulnar nerve supplies the lateral palm
The radial nerve supplies the lateral palm
Palmar cutaneous branch arises from the recurrent branch
Lateral palm is supplied by the musculocutaneous n.
savollar.izoh: Karpal tunnel: n. medianusning kaft teri shoxi kanal oldidan chiqib, retinakulum ustidan o'tadi - kaft markazi/lateral sezgisi saqlanadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 32 yoshli homilador ayolda o'ng bosh, ko'rsatkich va o'rta barmoqlarda uvishish va chimchilash kechasi uyg'otadi. Kaft usti kaft tomoniga urilganda simptomlar paydo bo'ladi. Tenar biroz zaif, lekin kaftning lateral qismi sezgisi normal.
savollar.savol_uz: Kaftning lateral qismi sezgisi nima uchun saqlangan?

savollar.vinyetka: A 25-year-old man cuts the thenar area of his left palm on broken glass. He cannot touch the tip of his thumb to the tips of the other fingers, and the thumb lies in the plane of the palm. Sensation of all digits is intact.
savollar.savol: Which nerve branch is most likely injured?
javoblar: Recurrent branch of the median nerve
Superficial branch of the ulnar nerve
Deep branch of the ulnar nerve
Palmar cutaneous branch of median nerve
savollar.izoh: Qaytuvchi shox sof motor: tenar (OAF) yo'qoladi - maymun panjasi, sezgi saqlanadi. Kaftdagi yuzaki kesilishda shikastlanadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 25 yoshli erkak chap kaftining tenar sohasini singan shishada kesib oldi. Bosh barmoq uchini boshqa barmoqlar uchiga tekkiza olmaydi, bosh barmoq kaft tekisligida yotadi. Barcha barmoqlar sezgisi butun.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi nerv shoxi shikastlangan bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori?

savollar.vinyetka: A 35-year-old long-distance cyclist has weakness of the right hand. When he tries to extend his fingers, the ring and little fingers claw. He cannot spread his fingers apart, and there is hypothenar wasting with numbness of the palmar little finger. Wrist flexion is normal.
savollar.savol: Where is the nerve most likely compressed?
javoblar: Ulnar nerve behind the medial epicondyle
Median nerve in the carpal tunnel
Lower trunk of the brachial plexus
savollar.izoh: Velosiped ruli n. ulnarisni Guyon kanalida (no'xatsimon va ilmoqli suyak orasida) siqadi: kuchli ulnar tirnoq, FCU va FDP saqlangan.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Uzoq masofaga velosiped haydovchi 35 yoshli erkakda o'ng panja zaif. Barmoqlarini yozmoqchi bo'lganda IV va V barmoqlar tirnoqlanadi. Barmoqlarini yoya olmaydi, gipotenar atrofiyasi va jimjiloq kaft yuzasida uvishish bor. Kaft usti bukilishi normal.
savollar.savol_uz: Nerv qayerda siqilgan bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori?

savollar.vinyetka: A 19-year-old man fractures the medial epicondyle of his left humerus. On examination, when he flexes his wrist against resistance, the hand deviates toward the radial side. He also has numbness of the medial 1.5 digits.
savollar.savol: Loss of which muscle explains the radial deviation?
savollar.izoh: Proksimal n. ulnaris shikasti: FCU ishlamaydi, FCR qarshiliksiz tortadi - bukilishda kaft usti radial og'adi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 19 yoshli yigit chap yelka suyagi medial epikondilini sindirdi. Ko'rikda kaft ustini qarshilikka qarshi bukkanda panja radial tomonga og'adi. Medial 1,5 barmoqda uvishish bor.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi mushak yo'qolgani radial og'ishni tushuntiradi?

savollar.vinyetka: A 66-year-old man with hypertension and hyperlipidemia reports dizziness and left arm pain whenever he chops wood. Blood pressure is 152/88 mm Hg in the right arm and 118/76 mm Hg in the left. The left radial pulse is weak.
savollar.savol: Which finding is expected on Doppler of the left vertebral artery?
savollar.izoh: Subclavian steal: chap a. subclavia vertebraldan proksimalda torayadi; qo'l ishlaganda qon vertebral arteriya orqali teskari oqadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Gipertenziya va giperlipidemiyasi bor 66 yoshli erkak har gal o'tin yorganda bosh aylanishi va chap qo'l og'rig'idan shikoyat qiladi. Qon bosimi o'ng qo'lda 152/88, chap qo'lda 118/76 mm sim. ust. Chap radial puls sust.
savollar.savol_uz: Chap umurtqa arteriyasi Dopplerida qanday topilma kutiladi?

savollar.vinyetka: Before radial artery cannulation in the ICU, the patient clenches the fist while the physician compresses both radial and ulnar arteries. The hand is opened and the ulnar artery is released while radial compression is maintained. The palm remains pale after 20 seconds.
savollar.savol: What is the most appropriate interpretation?
javoblar: Poor ulnar flow; avoid radial cannulation
Normal test; proceed with radial cannulation
savollar.izoh: Allen testi: ulnar qo'yib yuborilganda rang qaytmasa - ulnar oqim/ravoq yetarli emas; a. radialisga kateter qo'yish xavfli.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Reanimatsiyada a. radialisga kateter qo'yishdan oldin bemor mushtini siqadi, shifokor radial va ulnar arteriyalarni bosadi. Panja ochiladi va radial bosim saqlangan holda ulnar arteriya qo'yib yuboriladi. 20 soniyadan keyin ham kaft oqarib turibdi.
savollar.savol_uz: Eng to'g'ri talqin qaysi?
javoblar_uz: ulnar oqim yetarsiz; radialga kateter yo'q

savollar.vinyetka: A 54-year-old woman with end-stage renal disease is referred for creation of permanent vascular access for chronic hemodialysis on her non-dominant forearm.
savollar.savol: Which vessels are most commonly anastomosed?
javoblar: Brachial artery and median cubital vein
savollar.izoh: Klassik AV-fistula (Brescia-Cimino): a. radialis + v. cephalica kaft usti sathida; vena arterializatsiyalanib, kengayadi.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: Buyrak kasalligining oxirgi bosqichidagi 54 yoshli ayol surunkali gemodializ uchun dominant bo'lmagan bilagida doimiy qon tomir kirishini yaratishga yuborildi.
savollar.savol_uz: Ko'pincha qaysi tomirlar o'zaro tutashtiriladi?
javoblar_uz: yelka arteriyasi va tirsak o'rta venasi

savollar.vinyetka: A 28-year-old man has a deep stab wound to the proximal anterior forearm. He cannot flex the interphalangeal joint of the thumb or the DIP joint of the index finger and cannot make an 'OK' sign. Sensation of the hand is normal.
savollar.savol: Which nerve is injured?
javoblar: Recurrent branch of the median nerve
savollar.izoh: N. interosseus anterior (sof motor): FPL, FDP lateral yarmi, pronator quadratus. "OK" belgisi qilinmaydi, sezgi normal.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 28 yoshli erkak bilakning oldingi proksimal qismiga chuqur pichoq jarohati oldi. Bosh barmoq IP bo'g'imini va ko'rsatkich barmoq DIP bo'g'imini buka olmaydi, "OK" belgisini qila olmaydi. Panja sezgisi normal.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi nerv shikastlangan?

savollar.vinyetka: A 26-year-old weightlifter has weakness when flexing the right elbow and turning a doorknob. The biceps reflex is diminished, and there is numbness over the lateral forearm. Shoulder abduction, wrist and finger movements are normal.
savollar.savol: Which nerve is most likely injured?
javoblar: Upper trunk of the brachial plexus
savollar.izoh: N. musculocutaneus: biceps, brachialis, coracobrachialis; bilak lateral teri nervi bo'lib davom etadi. Abduktsiya normal - yuqori poya emas.
savollar.vinyetka_uz: 26 yoshli og'ir atlet o'ng tirsakni bukishda va eshik dastasini burashda zaiflik sezadi. Biceps refleksi pasaygan, bilak lateral yuzasida uvishish. Yelka abduktsiyasi, kaft usti va barmoq harakatlari normal.
savollar.savol_uz: Qaysi nerv shikastlangan bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori?

kartalar.savol: Yelka chigali bo'limlari tartibi (mnemonika)?
kartalar.javob: Radices - Trunci - Divisiones - Fasciculi - Rami (Remember To Drink Cold Beer)

kartalar.savol: Kaft usti kanalidan qaysi tuzilmalar o'tadi?
kartalar.javob: N. medianus + 4 FDS + 4 FDP + FPL paylari (n. ulnaris - Guyon kanalida)

kartalar.savol: Yelka suyagi sinishlarida nervlar tartibi?
kartalar.javob: A-R-M: n. axillaris (bo'yin) -> n. radialis (tana) -> n. medianus (suprakondilyar)

kartalar.savol: Orqa va kaft suyaklararo mushaklar vazifasi?
kartalar.javob: DAB - Dorsales ABduktsiya; PAD - Palmares ADduktsiya (n. ulnaris chuqur shoxi)

kartalar.savol: Tenar mushaklari va ularning nervi?
kartalar.javob: Opponens, abductor, flexor pollicis brevis (OAF) - n. medianus qaytuvchi shoxi

kartalar.savol: Lumbrikal mushaklar vazifasi va nervlari?
kartalar.javob: MCP bukish + PIP/DIP yozish; 1-2 - n. medianus, 3-4 - n. ulnaris

kartalar.savol: Erb falajida qo'l holati?
kartalar.javob: Adduktsiya, ichki rotatsiya, tirsak yozilgan, pronatsiya - "waiter's tip" (C5-C6)

kartalar.savol: Klumpke falajining belgilari?
kartalar.javob: To'liq tirnoq panja + bilak medial sezgisi yo'q + Horner (C8-T1)

kartalar.savol: Qanotsimon kurak qaysi nerv shikastida?
kartalar.javob: N. thoracicus longus (C5-C7) -> m. serratus anterior

kartalar.savol: N. interosseus posterior shikastining farqi?
kartalar.javob: Barmoqlar osiladi, sezgi yo'qolmaydi, kaft usti radial og'adi (ECRL saqlangan)

kartalar.savol: Ulnar paradoks nima?
kartalar.javob: Proksimal n. ulnaris shikastida tirnoqlanish kamroq (FDP ham yo'q), distal - kuchliroq

kartalar.savol: Gemodializ AV-fistulasi uchun tomirlar?
kartalar.javob: A. radialis + v. cephalica (Brescia-Cimino), oldin Allen testi

rasm_testlar.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain
rasm_testlar.savol: Panjaning chuqur mushaklari (kaft tomondan). '?' bilan belgilangan, n. ulnaris chuqur shoxi innervatsiya qiladigan va bosh barmoqni yaqinlashtiruvchi mushak qaysi?
javoblar: M. adductor pollicis - bosh barmoqni yaqinlashtiruvchi mushak
M. opponens pollicis - bosh barmoqni qarama-qarshi qo'yuvchi mushak
M. abductor pollicis brevis - bosh barmoqni uzoqlashtiruvchi qisqa mushak
M. flexor pollicis longus - bosh barmoqning uzun bukuvchisi
rasm_testlar.izoh: M. adductor pollicis (ko'ndalang va qiyshiq boshlar) - n. ulnaris chuqur shoxi. Shikastida Froment belgisi: qog'ozni FPL bilan ushlaydi.

rasm_testlar.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain
rasm_testlar.savol: Yelka arteriyalari (oldindan). '?' bilan belgilangan, n. radialis bilan birga bilak nervi egatida yotadigan arteriya qaysi?
javoblar: A. profunda brachii - yelkaning chuqur arteriyasi
A. circumflexa humeri posterior - yelkani aylanuvchi orqa arteriya
rasm_testlar.izoh: A. profunda brachii yelka arteriyasining birinchi yirik shoxi; n. radialis bilan egatda yotadi - tana sinishida ikkalasi shikastlanadi.

rasm_testlar.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain
rasm_testlar.savol: Kurak sohasi nervlari (orqadan). '?' bilan belgilangan, to'rt tomonli teshikdan o'tib deltasimon mushakni innervatsiya qiladigan nerv qaysi?
javoblar: N. dorsalis scapulae - kurakning orqa nervi
rasm_testlar.izoh: N. axillaris (C5-C6) deltasimon va teres minorni innervatsiya qiladi; jarrohlik bo'yni sinishi va yelka chiqishida shikastlanadi.

xulosa: Kaft usti kanali: n. medianus + 9 bukuvchi pay; n. ulnaris va a. ulnaris Guyon kanalida - tashqarida.
Yuzaki kaft ravog'i asosan a. ulnaris, chuqur ravog'i asosan a. radialis dan hosil bo'ladi.
Subclavian steal: vertebraldan proksimal stenoz, qo'l ishlaganda vertebral oqim teskari, bosh aylanadi, bosim farqi >15 mm Hg.
Allen testi: ulnar qo'yib yuborilganda rang 5-15 s da qaytishi kerak; gemodializ fistulasi - a. radialis + v. cephalica.
Yelka oldingi kompartmenti - n. musculocutaneus; orqa (triceps) va bilakning barcha yozuvchilari - n. radialis.
FDP va lumbrikallar ikki nervli: lateral qism - n. medianus, medial qism - n. ulnaris.
DAB - orqa interosseylar uzoqlashtiradi, PAD - kaft interosseylari yaqinlashtiradi; tenar va gipotenar - OAF.
Erb (C5-C6) - "waiter's tip"; Klumpke (C8-T1) - to'liq tirnoq panja + Horner; n. thoracicus longus - qanotsimon kurak.
Yelka sinishlari A-R-M: jarrohlik bo'yni - n. axillaris, tana - n. radialis, suprakondilyar - n. medianus, medial epikondil - n. ulnaris.
Duo panja - proksimal n. medianus; maymun panjasi - distal n. medianus; ulnar tirnoq - distal n. ulnaris (ulnar paradoks).
